nodes.text: It's this thing the school came up with last year because of budget cuts, but it was so popular, they couldn't cancel it!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Every Wednesday afternoon, you can just go home and do whatever!

nodes.text: You're at your locker when Sierra taps you on the shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Hey, $Michael!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Hey, Sierra! What's up?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Oh, not much. Just haven't seen you around lately, stranger.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Maybe we should hang out this weekend. It could be fun!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: You know, if I didn't know better, I'd think Sierra liked me... But that can't be right, can it?

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Seiler
nodes.text: $Michael, hm? I recognize you from Sierra's Popularity Updater page! It's so nice to finally meet you.

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Seiler
nodes.text: I really love seeing all of those wonderful pictures that Sierra posts. It makes me feel like I'm right there with her.

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Seiler
nodes.text: And I'm just so proud of Sierra for being a cheerleader. I was the head cheerleader back when I was in high school.

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Seiler
nodes.text: I'm sure Sierra's going to follow in my footsteps.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Aw, Mom!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Wow... I guess Sierra's got a lot of pressure on her.
You spend an hour talking with Sierra and her family until...

nodes.speaker: Doctor Patel
nodes.text: Well, that's it. Visiting hours are over for today.

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Seiler
nodes.text: Thank you for coming, $Michael.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: It was nice meeting you, Mrs. Seiler.
Mr. Seiler drives you back to his house, and you're about to head home when Sierra pulls you aside.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Thanks for being so cool about that. It's... It's not the easiest thing to deal with, I know.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Hey, I get it. I'm sorry that you have to go through this.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Thanks, $Michael. It means a lot to me.
Sierra gives you a kiss on the cheek.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Good night.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Seiler
nodes.text: Sierra, sweetheart, I hope you don't mind, but I thought your mother would like to meet this young man.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Oh! No... I don't mind. Mom, this is $Michael.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: I... I guess I just wasn't ready to talk about it...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I'm sorry. Maybe I shouldn't have come.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Seiler
nodes.text: Nonsense. Sierra, I brought him because I thought your  mother would like to meet him. I think she deserves to know the young man her daughter's been spending so much time with.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: I... I guess you're right. Mom, this is $Michael.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Congratulations! You deserve it.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Anyway, I've got to run to class! See you later!
After your first final...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hey, $Michael. Ready for the big science final tomorrow?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Yeah, I guess so.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: What's wrong? Girl trouble?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: You could say that. I'm dating this girl, and... Well, it's complicated.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hey, Angie and I have been dating for over a year now. It's never `not` complicated.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, Angie and I have been dating for over a year now. It's never [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] complicated.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: But you can't give it up. Just go talk to her. I'm sure you'll get it all straightened out.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Yeah... Maybe I should go talk to her. Thanks, $Scott.
You head over to Sierra's house... But when you ring the doorbell, her dad answers.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Seiler
nodes.text: Hello? Can I help you?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Oh, hello, sir. I was looking for Sierra.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Seiler
nodes.text: She's not here right now. She always visits her mom at the hospital on Mondays. Didn't she tell you?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: No... She's never talked about her mom.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Seiler
nodes.text: Well, that's not really a surprise, I guess. It's hard for Sierra to talk about it.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Seiler
nodes.text: But... Maybe I should take you down to meet Joanna. After all she's heard about you, I bet she'd really like to meet you.
Mr. Seiler drives you to the hospital and leads you to a room where you find Sierra sitting next to a woman lying in a bed.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Um, hello.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: $Michael? What are you doing here?

options.label: Your dad said I should come.
Why didn't you tell me about your mom?

nodes.text: Suddenly, out on the field, Zach scores the winning touchdown!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Go Zach!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Go Lizards!
The crowd goes wild! Zach runs over and high-fives the cheerleaders before stopping in front of Sierra.
Zach sweeps her up in his arms and gives her a big kiss!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Zach! What...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Huh? Oh, sorry, I got caught up in the moment. You know how it goes!
Zach runs back onto the field as everyone in the stands cheers!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: What was that?!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: I... I didn't know Zach was going to do that!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Look, if he thinks he can kiss you now, what's he going to think the night of the dance?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sierra! Back in formation!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: I've got to go. I'm sorry, $Michael.
You're at your locker when Sierra runs up...

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Hey! Guess what... I made the team!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I mean, I'll show up, and you can be with Zach, but maybe we can at least have a dance together.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Aw, $Michael...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I'm not crazy about it. But I know how important it is to you that you're on the cheerleading squad.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: That's... That's true, but it's more than just wanting to be a cheerleader... Oh, I can't explain it.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: You think I should quit?! Why?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: You need to send a message! Protest! Show Taylor that you aren't going to take this kind of treatment!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: I can't get kicked off the squad... I just can't. You don't understand.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Look, none of us like what Taylor's doing with the Kiss and Make Up Dance, but it was really nice of you to support Sierra.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Hey, I get it. Being on the squad is really important to her. I don't want to mess that up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're a really good guy, you know that? Sierra's lucky she has someone like you right now.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I mean... Oh, nothing. We'd better get to class. Come on, Sam.
You're walking to your locker when $ZOE and Sam come up to you in the hallway.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, $Michael. We wanted to talk to you for a minute.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Uh, sure. What's up?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: $Michael... That's... That's so sweet of you!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Hey, it's not like you're really dating the guy. It's just a silly dance.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Don't worry. I'll make sure everyone knows `you're` my boyfriend.
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't worry. I'll make sure everyone knows [color=#3b78e2][i]you're[/i][/color] my boyfriend.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Sierra...
Sierra gives you a sweet, lingering kiss.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: But... What are you going to do? Are you going to go to the dance at all?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I... I don't know... It might be kind of weird to go without a date.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Well, think about it. I'd feel terrible if you missed the dance because of me.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Don't worry. I'll figure something out.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I'm not going to spend the whole dance watching my girl with some other guy.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: But... Taylor's going to kick me off the squad!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: So? Is being a cheerleader worth more to you than our relationship?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: I just don't understand why I can only pick one. It's not like I have to actually date Zach!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Can't I just go to the stupid dance with him? I still like `you!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Can't I just go to the stupid dance with him? I still like [color=#3b78e2][i]you![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: How would you like it if I went and got some other date?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: $Michael!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Is that... Is that what you want?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I mean... I just think you should realize how this is going to make me feel.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: I'm sorry, $Michael. I know this situation sucks, but I... I just don't know what to do.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Could you please take me home now? I kind of just want to be alone right now.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Yeah, sure...
Just then you hear someone calling...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Sierra! Taylor needs the squad for an emergency announcement. Everyone's in the den. Er... Sorry, $Michael, but this is squad-only.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Oh, sure.
You wait a few minutes, and soon Taylor leaves the den and you see the meeting breaking up... You head into the den...

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: $Michael, this is terrible!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: What's going on? What was Taylor's announcement?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Taylor's pulling out this dumb tradition that all the cheerleaders have to go to the dance with players from the football team.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: What?! She can't do that.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Unfortunately, she can. And since `she` still doesn't have a date, she's decided that she gets to play matchmaker and set everyone up... Including herself.
nodes.text_bbcode: Unfortunately, she can. And since [color=#3b78e2][i]she[/i][/color] still doesn't have a date, she's decided that she gets to play matchmaker and set everyone up... Including herself.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That means Keith and I don't even get to have dates for the dance.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: My girlfriend's going to `kill` me. She already bought a dress!
nodes.text_bbcode: My girlfriend's going to [color=#e23b3b][i]kill[/i][/color] me. She already bought a dress!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: At least if Taylor would have told us sooner, we wouldn't have had to put up with Nicole complaining for the last three weeks.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Whatever. I don't really mind. Football players are `hot.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Whatever. I don't really mind. Football players are [color=#3b78e2][i]hot.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: I'm supposed to go with Zach.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You should be happy. Zach's hot!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: But I want to go with $Michael!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: So can't you just go with me? Why do you have to listen to Taylor?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Taylor's citing some esoteric rule about following all of the Centerscore traditions. Basically, if we don't go with who she pairs us up with, we're off the squad!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: I want to go with you, $Michael, but being a cheerleader has been my dream since I was a little girl!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Hey...

options.label: It's just a dance. Go with Zach.
I don't want you to go with Zach.

nodes.text: You jump out of the way as the water hits Sierra!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Eek! I'm... I'm soaked!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Let's see if we can find a towel to dry you off.
You and Sierra search the house and find a closet full of towels.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Here you go.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: You know, you look cute with your hair all wet.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Hee hee. Thanks.
You jump out of the way, pulling Sierra with you!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: That was close!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Thanks for saving me!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: What kind of a guy would I be if I didn't take care of you?
You freeze! Water splashes out of the pool and hits you and Sierra!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Eek! I'm... I'm soaked!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Let's see if we can find some towels.

nodes.text: Here you go.

nodes.text: You know, you look cute with your hair all wet.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Hee hee. Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hey, man! What's your problem?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: What? I'm not doing anything wrong. I'm just saying that your girl here used to be all over that Darren guy from Wilson High.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Who's to say she's not working for the other side?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: This sounds serious... I wonder what's going on...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: That's way out of line, Ryan! You better stop talking about Angie like that.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Oh yeah? You gonna make me?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: That's it.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Whoa, chill, dude!
Hector grabs $Scott and tries to pull him back.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Dude, `calm` down!
nodes.text_bbcode: Dude, [color=#e23b3b][i]calm[/i][/color] down!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Hey, just let him go and see what happens. I'm not afraid of him!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Oh yeah?
$Scott breaks free of Hector and tackles Ryan!
They struggle for a moment with Hector trying to pull them apart, then all three go tumbling into the pool! A big wave of water splashes out!

options.label: Pull Sierra out of the way with you!

nodes.text: You and Sierra go over to where a group of people are dancing...
When a slow song comes on, Sierra wraps her arms around you...

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: This is so romantic... Well, I mean, if it weren't for the fifty or so people around us...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Keep your hands off me, Ryan!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Aw, come on!
Ryan stalks off.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Heh. Yeah, I guess this isn't the most romantic atmosphere, but just wait till we're at the Kiss and Make Up Dance.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: It's going to be perfect! I'm so glad we're going together!
You and Sierra dance for a few more songs.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Hee hee! I didn't know you were such a good dancer.
Suddenly, you hear shouting coming from the backyard.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Ooh, let's go see what's going on!
You and Sierra go to the backyard...
You and Sierra follow Trev outside...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Trev, `please` stop telling people I'm going to light my arm on fire.
nodes.text_bbcode: Trev, [color=#e23b3b][i]please[/i][/color] stop telling people I'm going to light my arm on fire.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: You're not going to light...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I'm going to light my `sweater` on fire! Woo!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm going to light my [color=#e23b3b][i]sweater[/i][/color] on fire! Woo!

nodes.speaker: Trev
nodes.text: Woo!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Woo!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh, Spike, are you sure that's... Advisable?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Don't worry, I'm wearing, like, six sweaters.
Spike lights a match and sets his sleeve on fire!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Wooo! I'm on `fire!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Wooo! I'm on [color=#e23b3b][i]fire![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Trev
nodes.text: This is `awesome!`
nodes.text_bbcode: This is [color=#e23b3b][i]awesome![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Okay, now this is getting a little toasty.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Stop, drop, and roll! Stop, drop, and `roll!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Stop, drop, and roll! Stop, drop, and [color=#e23b3b][i]roll![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Forget that, just jump into the pool!
Spike jumps in the pool, and then climbs out to the cheers of the crowd!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Thank you, thank you. I'll be here all night.
Suddenly, you hear people shouting from the other side of the pool...

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Thanks! Here's your costume!
A few minutes later, you're dressed in a cowboy hat, a sheriff's badge, and a fake moustache.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: How do I look?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Like you run this town, Sheriff! Here, come pose with me.
Sierra pulls your arms around her!

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: Okay, now let's get a smile from the happy couple!
The clerk snaps the picture and points you toward the counter where you can pick it up.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Aw, we look great together!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Well, it's late... I better get home before my dad starts to worry. But...
Sierra leans in and gives you a kiss!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: I've had such a good time today, $Michael. Thank you for taking me here! This is the best date I've ever been on.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Me too.
Later that night, you show up at Sierra's house to pick her up for the party...

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Hey, $Michael!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Hey!
Sierra gives you a hug and kisses you on the cheek!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: This party is going to be so much fun!
Suddenly, Sierra's dad appears behind her.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Seiler
nodes.text: You must be the young man Sierra can't stop talking about.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Daaad!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: It's nice to meet you, sir.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Seiler
nodes.text: You kids be careful out there tonight. No reckless driving! No breaking the law! And $Michael, you'd better have Sierra home before eleven, or I'm calling the police.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Heh, that's a good one, Mr. Seiler.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Seiler
nodes.text: `I'm not joking.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm not joking.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Okay, now let's get out of here before my dad starts giving you some lecture about responsibility and good life decisions.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Uh... Good night, Mr. Seiler.
A short drive later, you show up to the big party at $Scott's house...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hey, $Michael! Come on in and make yourself at home! Hey, Sierra.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hey! Are you two... Together now?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: That's right.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Oh, I didn't see that on the Pop Updater. Usually that's the first thing everyone changes is their relationship status.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Well... Taylor said that cheerleaders aren't allowed to change their Pop Up statuses... She said that more boys would come to the games if they think they can date us...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, anyway, you kids have fun!
You and Sierra walk past $Scott and see the crowded living room.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Whoa! This place is `packed!` I think most of the school is here!
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa! This place is [color=#3b78e2][i]packed![/i][/color] I think most of the school is here!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh man, I still can't forget their faces after the prank! Those Wilson losers had no idea what hit them!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ooo, I love this song! Everybody watch me dance! Wooooo!

nodes.speaker: Trev
nodes.text: Hey guys! If you go outside, Spike's totally going to set his arm on fire! It's gonna be awesome!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: There are so many cool things going on. What should we go do?
You hand Sierra her costume, and a few minutes later, Sierra steps out of the changing room...

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: A corset, flouncy skirt, and a little hat! I love it!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: You look hot.
You hand Sierra her costume, and a few minutes later, Sierra steps out of the changing room...

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: A fake gun, a bandana, and a vest? I love it. I think I'm ready to go hold up the three o'clock train.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Ha ha! The train will have to wait. You look too good for us to skip taking a picture.
You hand Sierra her costume, and a few minutes later, Sierra steps out of the changing room...

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: A gingham dress, bows in my hair, and knee-high stockings? This is adorable!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: You're such a sweet girl, this seemed to fit you.
You hand Sierra her costume, and a few minutes later, Sierra steps out of the changing room...

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Jeans, a lasso, and a cowboy hat? Perfect!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: You look amazing.
Suddenly, Tex springs up from behind the saloon!

nodes.speaker: Tex
nodes.text: Hold it right there, Red. You're not taking anyone from our town!
The Red Bandit's gang and Tex shoot off their fake guns!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Whoa!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yipee!
When the smoke clears, Sheriff Tex is standing over the fallen bandits, twirling his pistols.

nodes.speaker: Tex
nodes.text: Now, I think that's enough excitement for one day in the wild west. You folks are free to go!
The actors all stand up and bow as the audience claps!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: That was awesome! I can't believe I got picked as the hostage!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Don't you lay a hand on her! The lady's with me, Bandit!

nodes.speaker: The Red Bandit
nodes.text: I... Uh... Er... Are we going off-script?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Er... $Michael, that's not part of the show.

nodes.speaker: Clementine
nodes.text: What he means to say is... Um... No one can stop us! Not you, not even Sheriff Tex!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Oh, my dearest Sierra! I'll miss you so... But who can stand in the way of the Red Bandit?

nodes.speaker: The Red Bandit
nodes.text: Exactly!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Hee hee! Oh, goodness me! Farewell, $Michael. Farewell, friends.
Sierra starts to walk towards the bandits. When she gets there, Clementine grabs her.
You freeze!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Good bye, $Michael. I must go.
Sierra starts to walk towards the bandits. When she gets there, Clementine grabs her.
Tex leads the horses away.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: So, what should we do now?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: It's sundown, so that means it's almost time for the Sundown Shoot Out!
You and Sierra follow the families and couples clearing off to the sides of the street. Suddenly, a gang of outlaws comes riding into town!

nodes.speaker: The Red Bandit
nodes.text: Hey! I'm the Red Bandit, and I own this here town!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Booo!

nodes.speaker: Clementine
nodes.text: Hey! Quiet down, you brat! Red, we better take a hostage, in case any of these people start getting ideas.
The Red Bandit scans the crowd... Then points at Sierra!

nodes.speaker: The Red Bandit
nodes.text: You, there! You're coming with us!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Me? Oh no!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: The Red Bandit's trying to take my girl! What should I do? Try to protect her, or play along and let her go?
Tex helps you climb onto Buttercup as Sierra swings into Lightning's saddle.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Easy, boy. Easy.
Lightning fidgets... And starts to kick!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: I said `easy!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I said [color=#3b78e2][i]easy![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sierra pulls on the reins, and Lightning settles down.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Good boy.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Wow. You really know how to handle that horse!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Thanks! Like I said, I've been coming here every year since I was little. I like a horse that's a little spirited.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Well, I'm pretty happy with ol' Buttercup.
Tex rides up to the front of the group on a brown mare.

nodes.speaker: Tex
nodes.text: All right, y'all. Follow me!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Okay, Buttercup. Let's go.
Buttercup twitches her ears and starts plodding forward.
Tex leads the group on a trail that twists and turns all around the lake.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Oh, isn't the sunset beautiful?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Yeah, this is nice.
As the ride ends, you both dismount your horses...

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: It was nice meeting you, Lightning.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Good girl, Buttercup.
You keep a vise-like grip on the reins for the rest of the trail...
The trail twists and turns all around the lake.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Oh, isn't the sunset beautiful?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Yeah, this is nice.
As the ride ends, you both dismount from your horses.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Good riddance.
Lightning nips at you!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Aw, it isn't his fault. He's just spirited.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Right...
The reins slip through your fingers! Lightning gallops on!

nodes.speaker: Tex
nodes.text: Whoa, Lightnin'!
Tex rides up beside you and grabs the reins.

nodes.speaker: Tex
nodes.text: Easy, big fella.
Tex pulls on the reins, and Lightning skids to a stop!

nodes.speaker: Tex
nodes.text: Here y'go. Keep a tight hold on these, now.
Tex hands you back the reins as Sierra rides up.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Are you okay?!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Yeah... But that was pretty intense.
You pull on the reins! Lightning skids to a stop!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Whew!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Are you okay?!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: That was... Intense.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Well, good work getting him to stop! A horse like that isn't easy to control... You must have a real knack for it!
You freeze! You fumble with the reins helplessly.

nodes.speaker: Tex
nodes.text: Whoa, Lightnin'!
Tex rides up beside you and grabs the reins.

nodes.speaker: Tex
nodes.text: Easy, big fella.
Tex pulls on the reins, and Lightning skids to a stop!

nodes.speaker: Tex
nodes.text: Sorry 'bout that. If he acts up again, you just pull on the reins.
Tex hands you back the reins as Sierra rides up.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Are you okay?!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Yeah... But that was pretty intense.
Tex helps you climb onto Lightning as Sierra swings into Buttercup's saddle.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Good boy. Good Lightning...
Lightning flattens his ears and glares back at you.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Good boy?
Tex rides up to the front of the group on a brown mare.

nodes.speaker: Tex
nodes.text: All right, y'all. Follow me!
The group starts to ride up the twisty mountain trail...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Slow down, Lightning!
Lightning bolts! He darts by the tour guide and starts racing along the edge of the mountain!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Whoa! Whoaaaa!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Pull on the reins! Pull on the reins!
You grab for Lightning's reins...
Later that day, you give Sierra a call...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Hey! Do you want to go out tonight?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Oh, hey, $Michael. Actually, I'm free today.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: My dad promised me we'd spend the day together and he'd take me to 'Western World'... But he had to cancel on me at the last minute.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Western World? Is that the theme park with all the cowboys and the wild west town?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Yeah, that's the one. My family used to go every year, starting when I was just a baby. It's kind of stupid, I know, but...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I think it sounds like fun! Let's do it!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Really? You're the best!
An hour later, you and Sierra enter the wild frontier of Western World...

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: I can't believe it! I'm so excited!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Oooh, the horseback tour is about to leave. You ride on a real horse along a scenic trail up and down the mountain.
You see families on horseback waiting for the tour to begin...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: I want to see a mountain lion!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: I want to `catch` a mountain lion!
nodes.text_bbcode: I want to [color=#3b78e2][i]catch[/i][/color] a mountain lion!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: There are a lot of kids here...

nodes.speaker: Tex
nodes.text: Howdy there m'am, mister. Here's two of our finest horses. We've got Buttercup here, the sweetest mare you'll ever lay eyes on!
Buttercup nuzzles Sierra's hand.

nodes.speaker: Tex
nodes.text: And we've got Lightning over on this side... The most spirited horse in the ol' west.
Lightning nips at Tex's hand!

nodes.speaker: Tex
nodes.text: Easy, fella. Now, saddle up, city slickers. Mister, which horse will you be takin'?

nodes.prompt: Mister, which horse will you be takin'?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Mister, which horse will you be takin'?

nodes.text: You punch Bryce right in the face!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: I'm a football player, kid. You'll need a lot more than that to take me down.
Bryce tackles you to the ground!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: $Michael! Help! Someone, help!

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Bryce, leave him alone. This kid didn't know who he was messing with.
James pulls Bryce off of you.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Heh. Sucker.
As Bryce and James walk off, Sierra kneels down next to you.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: $Michael, are you hurt?!
She wraps her arms around you, helping you stand.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I... I think I'm fine.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: I can't believe you took on that guy like that!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Hey, I wasn't about to let him get away with talking to you like that.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: You're so...

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: `Brave!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Brave![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: But you scared me half to death! I'd never forgive myself if something happened to you because of me.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Well, no harm done, right?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Right. At the very least, I guess tonight was very memorable.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: But I think I've had enough excitement for one night. I'd better get home before my dad starts to worry.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Okay. Good night, Sierra.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Sorry, man. You heard the lady.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: But I'm feeling pretty generous tonight, so how about I introduce you to some of the single girls here tonight?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: You see that table over there? `All cheerleaders.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You see that table over there? [color=#e23b3b][i]All cheerleaders.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Really? Okay! Deal.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: $Michael, right? You're an okay guy.
A few introductions later...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And you're all from Centerscore University?

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: That's right.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: In fact, I even went to Centerscore High. I can't believe I graduated before I met any of you.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: If I'd known you girls were coming, I'd have failed chemistry.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ha ha! Don't be sorry. College guys are way cooler.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Wow, that was pretty smooth. Thanks for coming to my rescue. This has been a really great night.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Thanks for inviting me to come along.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Of course! I'm always happy to see you, $Michael.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: I didn't know you were here, Zach!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Oh man... Zach is like Sierra's perfect guy... I wonder if she has a crush on him.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: The guys and I have been throwin' the ball around down by the water...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: If I'd known you were up here... I might have come up sooner.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Oh!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Anyway, we were just leaving.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Sure, sure. I didn't mean to hold you up.
You dodge to the side, the football landing in the sand.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Heads up! Sorry if we scared you, buddy. Didn't mean for that to go off-course.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Uh, yeah, no problem.
You snag the football out of the air.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Heads up! Nice catch, man.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Thanks. Here's your ball back.
You stand frozen as the ball hits you right in the forehead!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: $Michael!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Whoa, heads up, buddy! Sorry, some of the guys can't throw straight. You okay?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah. I'm fine.
You and Sierra sit with the cheerleaders, toasting marshmallows and talking as the waves start to roll in.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And that's why Taylor made Jill dye her hair.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's my favorite story.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Hey, it's almost high tide.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, we should probably get out of here before we all get soaked.
As you're standing up to leave, a football comes out of nowhere, headed straight for your head!

menu.title: Think fast!
menu.text: A football speeds towards your head!

nodes.text: You grab the skewer and throw it on the ground! You stomp on the marshmallow, putting out the fire.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: My... My marshmallow...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Oh... Oops...

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: It's okay. That was some quick thinking. I can always roast another one. I just hope your shoes aren't too sticky.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: They'll... Recover.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Aww, let me make it up to you by toasting you up a marshmallow! No fire this time, promise!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Heh.
You blow on the fiery marshmallow, putting it out!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Mmm, crispy and delicious! Thanks for saving my marshmallow!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: No problem!
You freeze! The fire spreads to the stick Sierra is holding!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Eek!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I gotcha!
Sam grabs the stick from Sierra and dunks it in a nearby bucket of saltwater.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Here. A little soggy, but at least you aren't on fire.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Um... I'll just grab a new marshmallow...
Amanda heads back towards Hector, who's waiting for her near the water.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: So, I guess you're in! Come on, let's go get some marshmallows!
You and Sierra go sit by the fire, where a group of cheerleaders and football players are roasting marshmallows.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Hey, Sierra! Who's your friend?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: This is $Michael.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: He's cute.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Hey, easy. He's with `me` tonight.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, easy. He's with [color=#3b78e2][i]me[/i][/color] tonight.

nodes.text: Sierra leans against you.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Sweet! I think Sierra's kind of into me!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Hey, can we get a couple of those marshmallows?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Here you go.
$ZOE hands you some stick skewers and marshmallows, and you and Sierra start roasting them over the fire.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So, congratulations on making the squad.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: I'm so excited to be a cheerleader. I just know everything's going to be perfect this year.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I remember when Sam and I first made the squad... I had that same feeling!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh, Sierra, you better watch your marshmallow! It's on fire!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Fire?! Eek! $Michael, help!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: $Michael! Have you ever even been to a football game?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Er, sorry. Football's not really my thing.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Well, maybe he can pretend he's on the squad. Here, have a pom-pom.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: This is kind of humiliating...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hey! My boyfriend, Hector, is on the squad!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Ack! I mean...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Forget it. Just try to blend in.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: $Michael! Have you ever even been to a football game?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Er, sorry. Football's not really my thing.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Well, maybe he can pretend he's on the squad. Here, have a pom-pom.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: This is kind of humiliating...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hey! My boyfriend, Hector, is on the squad!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Ack! I mean...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Forget it. Just try to blend in.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: That's right!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Is it? I never pay attention...

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Um... Yes. A field goal is worth 3 points.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Well, you should be able to pass for a football player!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Go have fun!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: $Michael! Have you ever even been to a football game?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Er, sorry. Football's not really my thing.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Well, maybe he can pretend he's on the squad. Here, have a pom-pom.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: This is kind of humiliating...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hey! My boyfriend, Hector, is on the squad!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Ack! I mean...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Forget it. Just try to blend in.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Oh, hey, do you mind taking a picture of me in the uniform? The cheerleaders let us use them for the tryouts...

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: But if I don't make the squad, this might be my only chance to get a picture in uniform.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I'm sure you'll make it! But I'll take the picture anyway, so you remember there was someone here helping you out on your rise to fame.
You snap a quick picture of Sierra.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: One more picture and you'll have to start paying me to be your personal photographer.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: I wish! I really got lucky having you as my locker neighbor. Anyway, it's getting late...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Yeah, I should probably get home.
You grab Sierra's legs... And lose your balance as Sierra falls on top of you!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Eek!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: That... Did not work the way I thought it would.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Oof. I thought you were going to grab my feet?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Sorry... I guess I got mixed up.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Are you okay?
You and Sierra both try to stand, and for a second, your face is just inches away from hers. She blushes and quickly stands up.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Um, well, I guess we can skip that part.
You grab Sierra's feet as she leaps into the air! You lift her high over your head!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Awesome! That was perfect!
Sierra jumps out of your hold and spins around. You catch her by her waist as she comes down.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: You're so strong, $Michael! Are you sure you've never done this before?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Uh, nope, first time.
You hold Sierra for a minute, your face just inches from hers before she blushes and pushes you away.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Well, I think we can check that off the list. Now I should be all ready for tryouts.
You freeze! Sierra jumps, but you don't catch her! She lands awkwardly and falls into you!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: What happened?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Sorry... I guess I choked.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Are you okay?
You and Sierra both try to stand, and for a second, your face is just inches away from hers. She blushes and quickly stands up.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Um, well, I guess we can skip that part.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: How can I have my perfect high school life if I don't make the squad?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: It would be unthinkable. Next thing you know, you'd be calculating the digits of pi at lunch with the nerds.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Hee hee. Exactly!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Oh, there's one other thing I couldn't practice on my own. The last part of the tryouts is a lift. Could you help me practice one?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Sure. Uh... What's a lift?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Here, put your hand right on my waist here... And then when I jump up, grab my feet and lift me up!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Ready to try it?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Yeah, I got this.
You put your hands on Sierra's waist.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Okay, here goes!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: What?! That's terrible!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Taylor has final say over who makes the squad, and she `never` picks anyone hotter than she is!
nodes.text_bbcode: Taylor has final say over who makes the squad, and she [color=#3b78e2][i]never[/i][/color] picks anyone hotter than she is!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Do you really think I look too hot? Maybe I could smudge up my makeup... Or tangle my hair...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Uh, I don't think you really need to do all that.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: You don't know what it's like... Rumor has it there was this really cute foreign exchange student last year...

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: And Taylor made `her` be the mascot!
nodes.text_bbcode: And Taylor made [color=#3b78e2][i]her[/i][/color] be the mascot!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Aw, I bet that's just a rumor the upperclassmen tell the freshmen.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: You think so?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Tell you what, if you end up as a lizard, I'll take you to the pony farm on top of the gym.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Oh, very funny! Now come on, this is serious.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: It's like you're already one of them.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Perfect! I've been studying Taylor, Nicole, and $ZOE all week...

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Thanks, $Michael.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: You really take this cheerleading stuff seriously, huh?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Of course!
You show up at Sierra's house, and she opens the door wearing her cheerleading uniform.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: $Michael! You made it! Thank you so much for coming! Come on in!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Of course.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Er, yeah, so, what's the deal with these cheerleading tryouts?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: We've got to show up in uniform and do the routine they taught us. I love these skirts!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: I'm going to wear this every day if I make the squad! You like it, right?
Sierra does a little spin for you in her cheerleader outfit.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Sierra is `hot.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Sierra is [color=#e23b3b][i]hot.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: So, I already memorized the cheer and the routine... Want to see it?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Yes. I would be interested in that.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Ready? Okay! Lizards fight to save the day! Lizards beat them every way!
Sierra does a flip.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Goooo... Lizards!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: And then we end in the splits like this!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Wow. Just... Wow.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: So what do you think? Will I make the squad?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: What should I say?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Sierra, you'll...

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: So? I saw you run today.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Skazz never even had a chance, and neither will Wilson High! I know you're going to be amazing.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: So what's with the pictures?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: I guess it's a little silly... Um...

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: ...It's how the popular kids act at school. They take a ton of pictures of themselves with their friends and put them online.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: You tag your friends and make goofy comments, and then everyone knows how popular you are!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Heh. I'm glad I can help your popularity.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Hey, the way Keith talked about you, it sounds like you're on your way to being a big track star!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: I've got to make sure you remember me when you're famous.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Ha! I haven't even had my first track practice yet.
You put your arm around Sierra, and she leans closer to you!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Awesome! Say cheese!
Sierra holds her phone out and clicks a button, taking a picture of the two of you together.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: How does it look?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Perfect! Like we're just destined to know each other.
You stick out your tongue and wait while Sierra holds her phone out and clicks a button, taking a picture of the two of you together.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: How does it look?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Hee hee!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: That bad?
You lean over her shoulder...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Aw, man! I look ridiculous!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Aw, don't be so hard on yourself. I think you look pretty funny, and that's what you were going for, right?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Heh, right.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Whoa. Harsh.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: See what I mean? But once I'm a cheerleader, I'll be able to go wherever I want. Tryouts are today after school... I've just `got` to make it.
nodes.text_bbcode: See what I mean? But once I'm a cheerleader, I'll be able to go wherever I want. Tryouts are today after school... I've just [color=#3b78e2][i]got[/i][/color] to make it.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Anyway, come on. For now, let's go sit near the window.
You and Sierra go sit down at one of the tables, and she hands you her phone.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Hey, my phone has a great camera in it. Snap a picture of me! It'll be fun to have a picture of my first high school lunch.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Heh. Sure.
You take the picture and hand her the phone back.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Perfect! Now let's get one together! Do something cute.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: The popular kids? You're joking, right?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: You can't sit with the popular kids until you majorly earn a reputation around here!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Really? I'm sure it can't be that bad...
As you're watching, a freshman walks over to the popular table...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ew! Ew! Freshman! Get away from here!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: The nerds? Seriously? First of all, not a great move unless you're trying to go straight down the social ladder.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Second, what makes you think they want us to sit with them? Look!
As you watch, a freshman girl walks over to the nerd table...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Hey, can I sit here?

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Ugh, a freshman.

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Look, freshman, we're kind of in the middle of a pretty serious debate, okay?

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Unless you can offer some compelling commentary on Nietzche's theories on the rise of the uberman, you can find another table.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: I want to go back to our vampire versus werewolf debate.

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Well, `some` of us are trying to have a serious conversation!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, [color=#e23b3b][i]some[/i][/color] of us are trying to have a serious conversation!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: The rebels? Really? They're not exactly the welcoming committee.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I don't know, they seem pretty laid back...
Just then, a freshman girl walks by the rebel table.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Hey, can I sit here?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Sure, just pay the toll.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Toll?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Yeah, you want to sit here? Pay up.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: But... I...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: You just thought we could all be friends? Look, upperclassmen don't associate with losers like you. Go find your own table, freshman!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Eep!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Good idea. We're definitely not popular enough to sit with any of the cliques. You've seen what happens to the freshmen who try, right?
As you're watching, a freshman walks over to the popular table...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ew! Ew! Freshman! Get away from here!
That day at lunch, you head into the cafeteria and look for somewhere to sit!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: I wonder if $Kelly's here somewhere... She's usually hanging out with her best friend, Peter. I bet I could crash their lunch table...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: If I could find it.

nodes.text: It looks like there are some popular students at that table...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So did you see what Jill wore to $Scott's party? Talk about trashy!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Trashy? More like `awesome!` I need to ask that girl out some time...
nodes.text_bbcode: Trashy? More like [color=#e23b3b][i]awesome![/i][/color] I need to ask that girl out some time...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: And the nerds are over at that table...

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: There is no way you can claim that a vampire would beat a werewolf in a fight! A werewolf would tear a vampire into pieces!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Not if the vampire has deep, sensitive eyes and a touching, tormented soul! You can't fight something that beautiful!

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Seriously, I'm not going to humor this debate any longer.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: And I guess those are the rebels in the back.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: So then I turn to the cop, and I'm like 'You can't give me a ticket if you can't catch me!' Then I jumped on my skateboard and raced off!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Ha! That's great!
Suddenly, someone taps you on the shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Hey, stranger! Would you mind some company for lunch?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Hey! Of course not! Let's go sit...
You're lying in bed when you get a text message.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: It's from Lauren!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: 'Slowpoke, if you're afraid of losing to me, I understand. But, I want to see you!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Hmm... Maybe I should spend some time with Lauren...
On Saturday night, you're sitting alone in your room, when the doorbell rings...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hey, $Michael!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Hi, $Michael!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hector and the guys didn't think it was good for you to be, in his words, `bro-nesome` after what happened with that Wilson High girl. But, since he's on the cheerleading team and Howard and Jacob are playing in the football game...
nodes.text_bbcode: Hector and the guys didn't think it was good for you to be, in his words, [color=#e23b3b][i]bro-nesome[/i][/color] after what happened with that Wilson High girl. But, since he's on the cheerleading team and Howard and Jacob are playing in the football game...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: We figured we'd come cheer you up!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: That's really nice, guys. Come on in.
A few hours later...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: So then I'm there in my chicken suit...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: And I'm wearing a hideous yellow dress!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Meanwhile, Amanda's supposed to make a toast, but she's talking `about` toast!
nodes.text_bbcode: Meanwhile, Amanda's supposed to make a toast, but she's talking [color=#e23b3b][i]about[/i][/color] toast!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Heh.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Thanks, guys, for helping me take my mind off Lauren...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: As for you, Lauren...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: I'm going to blast this all over Popularity Updater. I'm going to let everyone at Wilson High know that you're `dating the enemy.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm going to blast this all over Popularity Updater. I'm going to let everyone at Wilson High know that you're [color=#e23b3b][i]dating the enemy.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Alexei turns to leave, but stops himself...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Oh, and did you know that in his spare time, your little friend here's been pulling pranks against Wilson High?!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: $Michael?! Is that true?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Yes... But it's not like I'm pranking you!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: How could you?! I just... I can't believe you would do that!
Lauren shoots you a vicious glare before she grabs up her things and leaves.
The waitress arrives with the pot of chocolate...

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: She left?! You must have done something pretty bad...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: What makes you say that?

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: I can't speak for the lady, but I wouldn't abandon chocolate unless... Well... Ever.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I guess it is bad...
He sees you and storms over to your table!

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: Care for some chocolate?

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Oh my god! You can dip stuff `in chocolate!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh my god! You can dip stuff [color=#3b78e2][i]in chocolate![/i][/color]

nodes.text: You and Lauren order dessert.
Suddenly...
Alexei comes into the restaurant!
You dip the bread vertically, but as you pull out the skewer, the bread falls back into the pot!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Hahaha! No kiss for you, more bread for me!
The waitress brings out another round of bread for you and Lauren.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Bon appetit...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Awww... Come here.
Lauren pulls you close and gives you a nice kiss...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Cheese, extra bread, `and` kisses. Is there a catch?
nodes.text_bbcode: Cheese, extra bread, [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] kisses. Is there a catch?

nodes.text: You dip the bread in at an angle, blanketing it with melted cheese...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: A pro!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Mmm-mmm! That's great! Your turn!
You and Lauren alternate turns until...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Oh no! My bread fell in!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Heh! You know what that means...
Lauren pulls you close and gives you a long kiss...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I think I'm starting to like fondue!

nodes.text: They're all at this big party I was at earlier...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Oh! How'd you know no one would be here?

nodes.speaker: Maitre D'
nodes.text: Doctor... Awesome?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Yes, do we have a problem?

nodes.speaker: Maitre D'
nodes.text: No... No, sir.
After a few minutes...

nodes.speaker: Maitre D'
nodes.text: Awesome, your table is ready.
You and Lauren get seated at a table...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Hahaha. That was great!

nodes.speaker: Maitre D'
nodes.text: Oh, you do?
You sneak a quick peek at the reservation list.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Yes, for... Um... Jones.

nodes.speaker: Maitre D'
nodes.text: Ah, Mr. Jones. My deepest apologies!
You and Lauren get seated at a table...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: That was smooth, $Michael.
Just then, you hear people arguing near the pool!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hey, man! What's your problem?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: What? I'm not doing anything wrong. I'm just saying that your girl here used to be all over that Darren guy from Wilson High.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Who's to say she's not working for the other side?

nodes.speaker: Michael

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: 'i dont think thats such a good idea. ):'

nodes.speaker: Michael

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Hmmm...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: This turned out to be a much better date than I thought it would be!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Yeah it was...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I just wish we didn't have to keep finding out-of-the-way places...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: I don't know... It feels kind of dangerous in an exciting way.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: You know, like the more we're not supposed to be together, the more I want to risk getting caught.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I hadn't thought of it like that...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Yeah, thanks for the dangerous date!
Lauren leans in and gives you a quick kiss!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Call me.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Erasers!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Hahaha! And there's even a ladybug!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Now your collection won't be depleted.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Thank you, $Michael.
Lauren gives you a kiss on the cheek!

nodes.text: Just a bunch of candy!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Awesome! Now we have dessert!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Thank you, $Michael.
Lauren gives you a kiss on the cheek!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I'm getting kinda hungry...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Tell you what? I'll go get us some food, you pick out a prize.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Sounds like a deal... What kind of prize do you want?

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Surprise me!
You go look at the wall of prizes while Lauren gets the food...
You roll the ball perfectly down the center, right into the middle circle!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Piece of cake!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: That means we've got fifty tickets!
You roll the ball, but the pressure gets to you! The ball bounces off the edge of the circle, and rolls into the gutter.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: That's worth five tickets. We've only got thirty now...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Let's play something else now...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: How about skeeball?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Sounds good!
You head over to the row of skeeball games...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Looks like we get tickets based on how well we do.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: I wonder if we can get a good prize with our tickets...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Probably not... Unless you're really in need of an eraser shaped like a ladybug.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: My eraser collection `is` somewhat depleted...
nodes.text_bbcode: My eraser collection [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] somewhat depleted...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: That's worth twenty-five tickets! If you do can match me, we'll have enough to get something awesome!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: No pressure!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: And... Five! What a great bet!

nodes.text: You can't do one push-up?!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I guess not...

nodes.speaker: Lauren

nodes.speaker: Michael

nodes.text: Ugh...

nodes.text: Poison Missile!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: I had a really good time with you today, $Michael. Being with you helps me forget about winning that trophy for the Battle of the Schools...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: It doesn't seem to matter anymore. Even though we're supposed to be enemies, I can't help liking you... You big jerk!

nodes.speaker: Lauren

You call Lauren...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Hey, Lauren? You free tonight?

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: I think so... What'd you have in mind?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: It's a surprise. I'll text you the address. And don't cheat by looking up where it is online... Deal?

You meet Lauren at an arcade near Spartan Academy...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: I don't know, $Michael, an arcade? Kind of nerdy, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: It's perfect! None of these Spartan geeks care what schools we go to.

nodes.text: Yes! I broke my own high score again!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Still... I don't think I'm all that interested in...

nodes.text: It was the `only` game we had where I grew up! No one can beat my Brawny Bullfrog!
