nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Hahaha! It is `so` on.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hahaha! It is [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] on.

nodes.text: You start to put your quarter in...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Wait! Haven't you learned anything yet? We have to establish the stakes first!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Oh, right, what was I thinking?

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Let's keep it simple... Loser has to do five push-ups right here in the arcade!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: But you have to do yours with me sitting on your back!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: What?! How is that fair?

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: You're stronger!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Okay, fine. But you're not allowed to do those girl push-ups with your knees on the ground...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Agreed. Same goes for you!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Heh.
You both put your quarters in and navigate through the character selection screen...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Okay, pressure's on. Time to remember how this game works...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I need to use my tongue-whip when she's vulnerable, duck under her poison missile, and cover my ears during her Bullfrog bullhorn!
The game begins!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Bullhorn!
Later... You pass a souvenir store on the way out...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Jogging is nice, don't get me wrong... But this is even nicer!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I think you're making the stuffed animal jealous.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Hahaha!
You put your arm around Lauren...
She snuggles up against you!
You give Lauren a tender, lasting kiss...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I've got a better idea. Come on!
You lead Lauren to the Ferris Wheel and into a seat... It gently lifts the two of you up into the cool air.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Look, the sun is setting!
You head over to the Black Widow Maker and into the front seat. The car angles steeply upward as you climb higher into the air.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: This is so exciting!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: $Michael, are you okay? You don't look so good.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I don't feel so good...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I'll be okay...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I just have to distract myself by not thinking about things that'll make me sick...
After falling and rising a hundred times...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: That was awesome!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: I know! Let's go again!
You and Lauren ride the Black Widow Maker over and over until the sun sets...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: I didn't think anyone could ever keep up with me in coaster-riding!
She pulls you down to her and gives you a passionate kiss!
You stumble off the ride...
And race into the bathroom!
Later...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: I didn't realize you were feeling sick...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: It's okay. I think I got it all out of me.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: I really appreciate that you went on the ride for me...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: We used to come here when I was little...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: My mom would go on the rides with us and keep us from getting scared. And my dad would always buy me and my brothers whatever kind of food we wanted.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Sounds like a fun tradition.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: It was.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Thanks, $Michael... Just for being so sweet.
As you come around a building, you see the Ferris Wheel...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Here's my chance to get romantic!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Check it out, the Black Widow Maker! It's a roller-coaster that simulates what it's like to be inside a spider web! Let's go on that! Unless, of course, you're chicken...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: After all this boardwalk junk food, I don't know if my stomach can handle a coaster...

nodes.prompt: What ride should you go on?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What ride should you go on?

nodes.text: Lauren hands you some cotton candy...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Cotton candy always reminds me of when I used to come here with my family...
Lauren hands you a bag of popcorn...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Boardwalk popcorn always reminds me of when I used to come here with my family...
Lauren hands you a corn dog...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Boardwalk corn dogs always remind me of when I used to come here with my family...
Lauren hands you a funnel cake...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Boardwalk funnel cakes always remind me of when I used to come here with my family...
You and Lauren get in a line at one of the concession stands...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: By the way, I was thinking for our next date we could go to this really popular fondue restaurant that everyone's talking about; it's called Pretty Pretty Cheese.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Oh, um...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: I'm sorry, $Michael. I like you, but being seen with you is still an issue.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I understand...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Hey... That doesn't mean we can't still have fun!
You reach the front of the line...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Come on, I'm buying! What do you want?
Your clown's balloon pops first!
Lauren's clown's balloon pops first!
Lauren's clown's balloon pops first!
Lauren's clown's balloon pops first!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Water-gun race!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Yeah. How'd you know?

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: No, look, there it is!
The two of you sit down in front of a row of water-pistols pointed at clown faces.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: So, all you have to do is...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Shoot the water into the clown's mouth to blow up the balloon until it pops... I told you, I'm a master!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Okay then, so... How are we making this one more interesting?

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Wow... You Centerscore Chickens `can` learn.
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow... You Centerscore Chickens [color=#3b78e2][i]can[/i][/color] learn.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Look! For a prize you can win either a lizard or a badger! It's perfect!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: How about... Loser has to carry around the rival school's mascot for the day!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Why stop there? How about loser has to carry it around `and` bring it with them to the `Kiss and Make Up Dance!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Why stop there? How about loser has to carry it around [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] bring it with them to the [color=#3b78e2][i]Kiss and Make Up Dance![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Whoa! I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: `Buckaw-buckaw!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Buckaw-buckaw![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Is that a chicken sound?

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Duh. Obviously.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Fine, you're on!
You aim your water pistol at the clown in front of you... After a few tense seconds... The game starts!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Oh you are, are you?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Especially at...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Oh, we aren't? I didn't realize you were a Wilson High expert.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Yeah, I don't think anyone from Wilson could break a balloon with a dart, sink an impossible shot, or ever win at my personal best game, the...
You give Lauren a call...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Hey Lauren! Want to meet me at the boardwalk?

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Sure, Slowpoke.
You and Lauren meet at the boardwalk...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Good call meeting at the boardwalk all the way out here! This way, we won't bump into anyone we know!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Also, I do hope you realize that I'm a master at carnival games!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Really? That's funny because...

options.label: Wilson chumps aren't masters at anything.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Yaaaaah!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Hahaha! Looks like I'm the heroine of this duo. You can be my sidekick.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Great.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Great... Who?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I'm sorry. Great, Doctor Awesome.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Thanks, Sidekick $Michael.
Neither of you flinch...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I have an idea...
You excuse yourself and pretend to go to the restroom... After a minute or two, you sneak up behind Lauren...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: `BOO!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]BOO![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: `Ahhhhh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ahhhhh![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: $Michael, you got me!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I believe you're forgetting to address me by my real name...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Oh yes. Of course. What I meant to say was: 'Doctor Awesome, you got me.'

nodes.speaker: Piratica
nodes.text: I can never forgive you, Doctor Awesome. Even though you saved my life again.

nodes.speaker: Doctor Awesome
nodes.text: You might not be able to see, but your vision has astounded me once again, Piratica! Let's get married and vanquish tyranny together!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Come on, I'm pretty sure I know how this ends, and we should get out of here so no one sees us!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Okay...
You sneak out of the theater...
...And walk Lauren to her car.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: This sneaking around thing is actually kind of exciting.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Yeah... It is!
You lean in and give her a quick kiss!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Fast on your feet... In more ways than one.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Call me!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Looks like this is going great!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: $Michael?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: If you had gotten here on time, $Michael, you would have seen all the ads telling you to turn off your phone!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: You know what we should see? The latest Doctor Awesome movie! It's called `Doctor Awesome: Lethal Optome-three!` It's in 3D!
nodes.text_bbcode: You know what we should see? The latest Doctor Awesome movie! It's called [color=#3b78e2][i]Doctor Awesome: Lethal Optome-three![/i][/color] It's in 3D!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Sounds good! I'll see you there!
You get into the theater just as the movie starts playing...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Perfect timing! But I wonder where Lauren is...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Uh-oh. My phone!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey! We're trying to watch the movie, dumb...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Ugh. Who wants to see some idiot girl running around half-naked and helpless?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Yeah... Who's interested in `that?!?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah... Who's interested in [color=#e23b3b][i]that?!?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: I know! Stop screaming, find some clothes, pick up a sword, and start hacking zombies already!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: I do love a good laugh...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Too bad most comedies are stupid or gross. I mean, come on, one more joke about vomit and I'm going to, well, guess.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: I'm impressed! How'd you know?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I'm a genius.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Hahaha! Sure...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Ugh. The `last` thing I want to see is some whiny girl try to get some unrealistic fantasy guy to fall in love with her.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh. The [color=#3b78e2][i]last[/i][/color] thing I want to see is some whiny girl try to get some unrealistic fantasy guy to fall in love with her.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: I'm not some girly cheerleader, $Michael.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Sorry...
Later...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: This was fun, $Michael... Call me anytime!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Oh, but after I go, wait a few minutes before you leave... You know, because we probably shouldn't be seen together...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Yeah...
Lauren leaves.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: This girl's a lot of fun, but I feel silly sneaking around like this!
You call Lauren...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Hey Lauren!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Hi, Slowpoke.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Heh. You want to catch a movie tonight?

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: I do, but... I'm worried someone will see us together at the theater.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Don't be! We'll come into the theater late... No one'll even notice; they'll be too focused on the movie.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Hahaha! Exciting! Okay, I'm in! What should we see?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Your pick...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Oh no. You're not getting off that easy. Let's see how well you `think` you know me...
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh no. You're not getting off that easy. Let's see how well you [color=#3b78e2][i]think[/i][/color] you know me...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: All right. I accept your challenge.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: What kind of movie does Lauren like?

nodes.prompt: What kind of movie does Lauren like?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What kind of movie does Lauren like?

nodes.text: Lauren slurps up the last morsel of her ramen bowl.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Eat it and weep, Slowpoke!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I'm getting really tired of that nickname...
A few moments later, you clear your throat, getting the attention of the other customers...

nodes.speaker: Caroline
nodes.text: Hey, girls, shhh! Lunch `and` a show!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, girls, shhh! Lunch [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] a show!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Um...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: If I could be a Badger, that would be so swell. I wouldn't be so ugly, I would never smell.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Instead, I'd be a furry ball of absolute perfection. Which is better than a scaly Lizard with a horrible complexion.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Is there anything more pathetic than someone with no talent using their non-talent to try to get attention?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Nothing is more pathetic than whatever we just saw...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I'm so embarrased...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: I'm so happy!
You slurp up the last morsel of your ramen bowl!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: I don't believe it! You crushed me!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Your pending embarrassment was my fuel.
A few moments later, Lauren stands up and clears her throat, getting the attention of the other customers...

nodes.speaker: Caroline
nodes.text: Hey, girls, shhh! Lunch `and` a show!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, girls, shhh! Lunch [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] a show!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: { { { I loooooove! To loooooooove! Your loooooooooooooooove! { { {

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Wow. Some people just shouldn't sing.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ever.
Lauren sits back down to mild applause.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: I'm so embarrased...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I'm so happy!
Lauren slurps up the last morsel of her ramen bowl.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Eat it and weep, Slowpoke!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I'm getting really tired of that nickname...
A few moments later, you clear your throat, getting the attention of the other customers...

nodes.speaker: Caroline
nodes.text: Hey, girls, shhh! Lunch `and` a show!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, girls, shhh! Lunch [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] a show!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Um...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: If I could be a Badger, that would be so swell. I wouldn't be so ugly, I would never smell.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Instead, I'd be a furry ball of absolute perfection. Which is better than a scaly Lizard with a horrible complexion.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Is there anything more pathetic than someone with no talent using their non-talent to try to get attention?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Nothing is more pathetic than whatever we just saw...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I'm so embarrased...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: I'm so happy!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: We just can't be seen together...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Wait... What if we go somewhere where we won't be seen?

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Granted, I don't know you very well, but the little I do know about you, I like.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Smooth.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: And I don't want to abandon someone I like just because we're supposed to be enemies.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Okay, okay, I concede you have a point. Follow me... And try not to look, I don't know, like a Centerscore Chicken.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Lizard!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Whatever.
You follow Lauren out of the park, along a secluded trail to a ramen house...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: This is seriously the middle of nowhere. The only students here are people I've never seen before...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: So my dad `won't` let me have a party on our yacht this weekend... It's unfair!
nodes.text_bbcode: So my dad [color=#3b78e2][i]won't[/i][/color] let me have a party on our yacht this weekend... It's unfair!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Life's real hard, Prissy.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: I can always ride my horse.

nodes.speaker: Caroline
nodes.text: I love noodles so much!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: How'd you ever find this place?

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: I can get a little over-competitive...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: I jog on unbeaten paths sometimes, to be alone and unwind. I can just run without trying to think about beating anyone. And one day, I just ran right by this place.
Your waiter comes to your table, and you both order large bowls of beef ramen. A few minutes later... Your food is brought to you.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I don't know if I can eat all this!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Hahaha! I `know` I can, but I'm a champion eater.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hahaha! I [color=#3b78e2][i]know[/i][/color] I can, but I'm a champion eater.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Really? Because I am, too, and I'm like twice your size...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Size shmize. Have you seen those professional eating contests? The winners are always like three feet tall.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: It's on then. What are we eating for?

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: `When` I win, you have to recite a poem about how great Wilson is!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]When[/i][/color] I win, you have to recite a poem about how great Wilson is!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Never!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Sounds like I came up with a good bet...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Okay, fine. But `when` I win, you have to sing a sappy love song at the top of your lungs!
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, fine. But [color=#e23b3b][i]when[/i][/color] I win, you have to sing a sappy love song at the top of your lungs!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Oh no, I'm a terrible singer!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Looks like we've got a deal...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: First one to finish wins!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I run for Centerscore.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: What?! What are you doing hanging around with this Centerscore loser, Lauren?!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: We just met. Relax.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Relax?! Badgers and Lizards, `don't mix, Gary!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Relax?! Badgers and Lizards, [color=#e23b3b][i]don't mix, Gary![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Don't let me catch you near her again. If I do, I'll make sure you `both` have real tough times explaining to all your friends what you're doing with the `enemy.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't let me catch you near her again. If I do, I'll make sure you [color=#e23b3b][i]both[/i][/color] have real tough times explaining to all your friends what you're doing with the [color=#e23b3b][i]enemy.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Alexei glares at you, then runs off.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: I can understand why you didn't lie, $Michael, but I think you can understand now why `I` tried to.
nodes.text_bbcode: I can understand why you didn't lie, $Michael, but I think you can understand now why [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] tried to.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: You could go to Monarch Prep for all I care. As long as you're not a Centerscore loser, you're a friend of Wilson.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Yeah, um, Gary's giving me all kinds of training tips to beat them with!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: `G`et `A`round `R`unning, `Y`es! That's the G.A.R.Y. system!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]G[/i][/color]et [color=#e23b3b][i]A[/i][/color]round [color=#e23b3b][i]R[/i][/color]unning, [color=#e23b3b][i]Y[/i][/color]es! That's the G.A.R.Y. system!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Right... Whatever makes you better, I guess. See ya around.
Alexei runs off...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: The G.A.R.Y. system?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: It just came to me.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Look, $Michael, I'm glad you covered for us there, and you seem nice, but...
You go out for a run, looking for Lauren... And find her doing jumping jacks in the park!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: $Michael! What are you doing here?
Just then, a guy with a 'Wilson High Track' shirt runs by!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Hey, Lauren, who's your friend?

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Alexei, this is... Gary. He runs for Spartan Academy.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Listen, don't think this is over! I want a rematch! I'll be here the same time next week. That is, if you're man enough to race me again!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: You're intense!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: I don't take defeat lightly. After all, I'm the captain of the girls' track team over at Wilson High!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: This isn't over!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: If you want a rematch, I'll be here the same time next week.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: And don't sweat the loss. I'm the captain of the girls' track team over at Wilson High!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: `Wilson?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Wilson?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Yeah, I'm training extra hard so that we can take it to Centerscore High in the Battle of the Schools!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: I want to put another Battle of the Schools trophy in the trophy room!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: You guys have a trophy `room?`
nodes.text_bbcode: You guys have a trophy [color=#e23b3b][i]room?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Yeah, it's big, too!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: This is probably the worst thing to say right now, but... I'm on the track team at Centerscore.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Yeah. We're... `Enemies!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah. We're... [color=#e23b3b][i]Enemies![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Wow... I... I don't know what to say...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Well... Are we still on for that rematch?

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Rematches are always on. I'll just have to run extra fast now that I know who I'm up against.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Hahaha! Maybe I do...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Hahaha! Exactly the kind of thing I expect from a slowpoke!
The two of you huff and puff at the finish line.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Hey, I'm Lauren.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: $Michael. You always cheat?
You cross the line ahead by only a few paces!
She crosses the line a few steps ahead of you!
You sprint as fast as you can!
You cut through the park, weaving your way through trees and bushes...
And emerge right before the finish line... Barely ahead!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Hey! Cheater!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Sorry, I couldn't hear you from all the way up here.
She starts catching up!
You slowly cut her lead down...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Finally decided to show up to the race, eh?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Ouch.
The finish line is in sight!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: I have an idea... Why don't we step this up a notch?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: What'd you have in mind?

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: First one around the park and back to here wins!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Okay, you're on! On the count of three... One...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Three!
She takes off running! You run after her, but are quickly behind by a large gap.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Hey! Cheater!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: What was that? I couldn't hear you from all the way up here.
You try to catch up, but the gap between you grows...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: This girl is bionic! Hmm... Maybe I could take a shortcut through the park... Or, I could keep trying to catch up the honorable way...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: What?! That doesn't make any sense!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I, um, just wanted to distract you so I could pass you up!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Right...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Hey! Why don't you come back here and say that?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I would, but I'm incapable of running so slowly...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Hahaha. Jerk.
You pass her without saying anything...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Okay. Now this is weird.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Listen, Slowpoke...

nodes.prompt: Later that day, you're jogging through a nearby park when a pretty, athletic girl passes you!

nodes.text: You speed up, passing her on her left!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Jogger on your right, slowpoke!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Slowpoke?! I can't let that lie! Especially not from a girl this `hot!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Slowpoke?! I can't let that lie! Especially not from a girl this [color=#e23b3b][i]hot![/i][/color]

nodes.text: You speed up, passing her on her left!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Time to say something clever...

options.label: It takes one to know one!

nodes.text: Your javelin sails farther than anyone's!
You see $Kelly in the stands, cheering!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Great throw, $Michael!
After the meet...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: That was unreal!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: You just broke the school record!
Record Broken!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Congratulations! You're absolutely in this event for the Battle of the Schools!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I didn't expect you to excel at javelin, $Michael! That was a sweet throw! Not better than the school record, but still...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Congratulations! You're in this event for the Battle of the Schools!
Your javelin falls short!
You see $Kelly in the stands...

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Don't worry about it, $Michael.
After the meet...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Well, to be honest, $Michael, javelin's one of those events that's hard to predict...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Dex here's a whiz at it, yet some of the guys on the football team can't throw a javelin to save their life.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: You're just not a javelin-thrower...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Gather up, everyone!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Only two more meets before the Battle of the Schools! This is our final push! Great work out there today! See you next week!

nodes.prompt: What event do you want to try?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What event do you want to try?

nodes.prompt: What event do you want to try?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What event do you want to try?

nodes.text: On Friday, you head over to the track to try another event...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Hey, $Michael! Just one event going on today that you haven't tried yet. Good luck!

nodes.prompt: What event do you want to try?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What event do you want to try?

nodes.text: On Friday, you head over to the track to try another event...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: We've got two events going on today that you haven't tried yet. Which one do you want to do?
You drop the baton!
You look at your family in the stands. They deftly avert their eyes.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, Sammy, you see that? Other people drop the baton, too!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why are you smiling?! This is your team, too, Colt!
Sam storms off.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: If you talk to me again, $Michael, I swear I'll pierce you with one of Dex's javelins.
Colt crosses the finish line...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: That's just not going to cut it at the Battle of the Schools...
You see your family's sad faces in the stands...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Well, this is the team, so all we can hope to do is get better.
Colt crosses the finish line...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: That's exactly what I wanted to see!
You can hear your family cheering for you from the stands!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Atta boy!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Way to go, cuz!

nodes.speaker: Gayle
nodes.text: Yay, $Michael!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Okay, everyone! Battle of the Schools is `next week!` Be prepared!
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, everyone! Battle of the Schools is [color=#e23b3b][i]next week![/i][/color] Be prepared!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Time to make the hand-off to Colt!
She hands the baton off to Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Not bad, Kimi. Keep up the pace, $Michael!
Kimi hands the baton off to you...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't really care, but it's nice to know I'm better than you without having to really try.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Glad I could help.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Just felt like sharing...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: This is our last practice before the Battle of the Schools, so let's finish strong!
You head toward your position. Colt stands in your way...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: What's up, Colt?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: As you all know by now, I won't be competing in the relay... But I'm confident that $Michael can step it up and fill my shoes...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He'd better!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Easy, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Let's just get this right in practice today...

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Where are you going?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: That's what I like to see. `Focus.`
nodes.text_bbcode: That's what I like to see. [color=#e23b3b][i]Focus.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: One second, Colt...

nodes.speaker: Aunt Martha
nodes.text: Here let me take a photo of you in your track uniform!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Aunt Martha...

nodes.speaker: Gayle
nodes.text: Be as jumpy as a kangaroo, okay?

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Oh! I think your teammates might be upset!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: $Michael!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Uh-oh... Sorry guys, I gotta go.
You run over to your team...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You've got to focus more, Freshman!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: $Michael! Get over here!
It's time for your last practice before the Battle of the Schools!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: $Michael!
You see your family, $Kelly, and her mom in the stands!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Unfortunately, I haven't seen that explosiveness I saw back on the first day...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: But who knows? Maybe you're a champion javelin-thrower!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: It's too late. It just means you're going to have to step it up, $Michael.
As you come out onto the track, you see Keith...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Keith, what's wrong? What's the matter?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: It's Wilson High... I thought we were in the clear, since we don't have any plays, but they found a way to sabotage us!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: What?! How?!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Every Battle of the Schools, each school submits a list of what athletes will be competing in what event. Normally it's a formality...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: This year, Wilson must have had someone on the inside, because I just got a reply that says I'm competing in all the events I never train for.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: It also means I won't be running the relay...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: They can't do that!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Okay, this is the last time. I have to go get warmed up...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Keep your elbow up, take thirteen steps, lean backward, follow through, and throw at a thirty five degree angle.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Got it?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Got it!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Great!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I can't teach you what I know in ten minutes, but I `can` give you five basic tips. Try your best to remember these because they'll make the difference in your tryout...
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't teach you what I know in ten minutes, but I [color=#e23b3b][i]can[/i][/color] give you five basic tips. Try your best to remember these because they'll make the difference in your tryout...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Keep your elbow up, take thirteen steps, lean backward, follow through, and throw at a thirty five degree angle.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Got it? Do you need to hear those again?

nodes.prompt: Do you need Dex's tips again?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Do you need Dex's tips again?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: You can't throw a javelin with a formula, Dex.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: It's strength, pure and simple.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: $Michael...
Dex exposes his bicep and flexes... There isn't even a whisper of muscle.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: That must have been some formula!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: It was...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: But it took me weeks to invent!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: So it shouldn't take you that long to remember! Didn't you come up with some kind of mnemonic or something to remember it by?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Oh, that's right!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: My mnemonic was M.N.E.M.O.N.I.C! I totally forgot!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Thanks, $Michael!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: The mnemonic is more for advanced throwing...
On Friday, you go to the locker room to change for track practice...
And find Dex in the locker room, crying!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: What's wrong, Dex?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Nothing too critical! Only that my system for perfect javelin-throwing was stolen with our playbooks!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: You had a perfect javelin-throwing system?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Yeah, it was a formula that took me `weeks` to perfect. With it, I was a warrior-Hercules with a deadly accurate javelin.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, it was a formula that took me [color=#e23b3b][i]weeks[/i][/color] to perfect. With it, I was a warrior-Hercules with a deadly accurate javelin.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Now, I'm just a feeble-looking nerd with what might as well be an over-sized number two pencil.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I don't think things are completely hopeless, Dex. After all...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, $Michael! As much as your family moment makes me want to take a photo for my scrapbook, we're meeting over here.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: What happened out there?!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I guess I'm not a hurdler...

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: I guess not. I used to jump over hurdles in my sleep, so I don't understand what the problem is...

nodes.speaker: Gayle
nodes.text: I think they make the hurdles too high...
You win the race!
You lose the race!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Final stretch!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Whoops! Maybe I can clear the next one!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Cleared it!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Whoops! Maybe I can clear the next one!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Let's see if hurdling's your event...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Okay, yeah. If I walk it off, I should be ready to go by the time the race starts...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Thanks, $Michael!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Okay... you're totally right. I'll tell Keith...
Later, as you're warming up...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: $Michael!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You were right! Keith was really happy that I told him about my leg cramp and he showed me a technique to get rid of it!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Thanks! You're the best!
You look back at where Lauren was standing, but she's gone.
You return to the team...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Listen up everyone, we don't have a whole lot of time before the Battle of the Schools!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: It's obvious a lot of you are dedicated, but I can assure you, Wilson's probably working just as hard as we are. We need to keep that intensity up!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: See you next week!
You head over to the hurdling area... And find Kimi lying on the ground holding her leg!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: $Michael! Help! I don't know what to do!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I was just warming up and my leg starting cramping...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: So... Why don't you tell Keith?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You don't understand! I've been totally sucking! He'll kick me off the team, I know it! And if I let the team down, my life will be `ruined!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You don't understand! I've been totally sucking! He'll kick me off the team, I know it! And if I let the team down, my life will be [color=#3b78e2][i]ruined![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I don't think it's that bad... I think you should...
You try to plant the pole, but lose your footing, and sprawl out onto your face!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Ow!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I didn't even know that was possible! Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I think so... I guess I got distracted.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Distracted?! You were `distracted?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Distracted?! You were [color=#3b78e2][i]distracted?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Of all the days for Wilson High to come watch us...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's fine. But... Look, I don't think pole vaulting is the event for you.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I... I understand.
You stay focused, and plant the pole...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Now I just have to clear the bar!

nodes.prompt: Rise up and clear the bar!

nodes.text: You lift yourself up into the air and...
You soar over the bar!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I... I don't believe it! That was amazing! You just beat my old record!
Record Broken!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: We'll `definitely` need you to pole vault during the Battle of the Schools! You're in this event!
nodes.text_bbcode: We'll [color=#e23b3b][i]definitely[/i][/color] need you to pole vault during the Battle of the Schools! You're in this event!

nodes.text: You clear the bar!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That was pretty good...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Come on, Sam, you know that was better than your best.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: $Michael, you're in this event for the Battle of the Schools!
Your body smacks into the bar!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Grr! That was terrible! You're making us look pathetic in front of Wilson High.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: You don't need to remind me...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Look, I'm sorry, but I don't think pole vaulting is the event for you.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I... I understand.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Still... It's like they're trying to learn all of our tricks or something.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Is that what Lauren's up to? Or did she come to see me?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Just ignore her. If you let her get in your head, she'll really win.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay, okay. Now, let's see that pole vault.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Lauren's watching... I've got to keep my focus!
You feel the weight of the pole in your hand... You start your run!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You can't be serious! The last thing Wilson High will ever be considered is `harmless!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You can't be serious! The last thing Wilson High will ever be considered is [color=#3b78e2][i]harmless![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Simmer down, Sam. You're right, Wilson High is a threat... But there's nothing we can do. Anyone can come sit in the bleachers.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Exactly!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We know what they're up to. We've got to stop them!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Simmer down, Sam. Anyone can come sit in the bleachers.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Keith can get a little carried away some times with evaluating talent.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Personally, unless I saw you using a tree branch to vault over another freshman, I wouldn't let you even touch a pole.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But it's Keith's call.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: What happened out there, son? You get nervous or something?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Well, `I` know. You can't get nervous just because your old man's here. There are going to be plenty more people when you guys compete against Wilson!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] know. You can't get nervous just because your old man's here. There are going to be plenty more people when you guys compete against Wilson!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: That's true...
You blast across the finish line!
Record Broken!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Wow, $Michael! I've never seen `anyone` run that fast!
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow, $Michael! I've never seen [color=#e23b3b][i]anyone[/i][/color] run that fast!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: You're in this event at the Battle of the Schools for sure!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: You might even be able to break the state record!
You win easily!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: $Michael, that's what I like to see. You didn't break the school record, but that was pretty fast!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Congratulations! You're in this event for the Battle of the Schools!
You fall on your face!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Oof!
Colt breezes across the line ahead of you...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Don't beat yourself up about it, $Michael. There are other events we can try you out in. You're just not a sprinter, I guess.
Before meeting back up with the team, your dad calls to you from the stands...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Let's see how you are at sprinting...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: $Michael! Get over here, would you?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Let's get one thing straight, $Michael...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Good luck!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Why? Are you saying I'm going to need it against you?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: No, just... Good luck.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: You ready to choke on my dust?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I don't want to be embarrassed again... I need to get in shape!
You let go, missing the platform!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Try again, $Michael!
You try a couple times, eventually landing on the platform...
You hang on a notch too long, but manage to right yourself on the platform...
You hang on a notch too long, but manage to right yourself on the platform...
You land soundly on the platform!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Excellent!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Okay! Time to let go!
You let go, missing the platform!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Try again, $Michael!
You try a couple times, eventually landing on the platform...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Stay with it!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Don't let go...
You let go, missing the platform!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Try again, $Michael!
You try a couple times, eventually landing on the platform...
Your foot collides with a tire, and you fall right on your face!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Oof!
You stand back up and plod your way through the tire dash...
You deftly alternate your feet, passing the tire dash!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Wow!
You deftly alternate your feet, passing the tire dash!
Your foot collides with a tire, and you fall right on your face!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Oof!
You stand back up and plod your way through the tire dash...
Your foot collides with a tire, and you fall right on your face!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Oof!
You stand back up and plod your way through the tire dash...
You deftly alternate your feet, passing the tire dash!
You deftly alternate your feet, passing the tire dash!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Wow!
Your foot collides with a tire, and you fall right on your face!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Oof!
You stand back up and plod your way through the tire dash...
Your foot collides with a tire, and you fall right on your face!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Oof!
You stand back up and plod your way through the tire dash...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Oh man! The tire dash! I've just got to make sure to alternate my feet!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I'll start with my...
You struggle repeatedly to climb the wall...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Oof!
Eventually, you pull yourself over it...
You sling your body over the wall and keep progressing...
You sling your body over the wall and keep progressing...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Whoa! You're on a record-setting pace!
You sling your body over the wall and keep progressing...
You struggle repeatedly to climb the wall...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Oof!
Eventually, you pull yourself over it...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Now, let me give you a quick introduction to each event's current leader...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: For the `hundred meter dash,` Colt is our top guy.
nodes.text_bbcode: For the [color=#e23b3b][i]hundred meter dash,[/i][/color] Colt is our top guy.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'll stand here, but I told you, I'm not going to say anything cheery or inspiring.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Don't worry, everyone, he'll grow on you. And, believe me, `he's fast.` I saw him outrun a guard at the mall once `while carrying a television!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't worry, everyone, he'll grow on you. And, believe me, [color=#e23b3b][i]he's fast.[/i][/color] I saw him outrun a guard at the mall once [color=#e23b3b][i]while carrying a television![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I was holding it for a friend...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Moving on... Sam is our `pole-vaulting` pro...
nodes.text_bbcode: Moving on... Sam is our [color=#e23b3b][i]pole-vaulting[/i][/color] pro...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Go Lizards!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: As you might have guessed, she's also a cheerleader.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: For `hurdling...` Oh, yeah, I forgot... All our hurdlers graduated last year...
nodes.text_bbcode: For [color=#e23b3b][i]hurdling...[/i][/color] Oh, yeah, I forgot... All our hurdlers graduated last year...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Psst... Did you hear that, $Michael? I'm totally going to be a hurdler!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: And Dex here is our `javelin`-throwing genius.
nodes.text_bbcode: And Dex here is our [color=#e23b3b][i]javelin[/i][/color]-throwing genius.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: It's more about geometry than strength.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Last, there's the `relay` race. We'll need everyone in tip-top shape since that one counts for more points than anything else at the Battle of the Schools.
nodes.text_bbcode: Last, there's the [color=#e23b3b][i]relay[/i][/color] race. We'll need everyone in tip-top shape since that one counts for more points than anything else at the Battle of the Schools.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Okay, enough for introductions... Follow me!
You walk over to a `huge` obstacle course set up in the middle of the field.
nodes.text_bbcode: You walk over to a [b]huge[/b] obstacle course set up in the middle of the field.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: This is what I like to call `Keith's Hatemaker.` I call it that because if you don't hate me yet, you will by the time you're done with it.
nodes.text_bbcode: This is what I like to call [color=#e23b3b][i]Keith's Hatemaker.[/i][/color] I call it that because if you don't hate me yet, you will by the time you're done with it.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: This is how you'll make your first impression on us. As we all know, you only get one chance for first impressions, so, try your best.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: It is tradition for the person with the slowest time to wash everyone else's sweaty gear. Hopefully, that's incentive enough for you to make this first impression really good!
One-by-one, the other athletes take their turn at the course. Soon, it's your turn... You toe the starting line...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Okay, $Michael, ready? Go!
You push off the starting line!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: The first obstacle is a wall! I need to climb over it!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: At practice every Friday, you'll compete in an event against that event's current leader.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Whoever wins will represent Centerscore for that event in the Battle of the Schools.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Don't worry about hurting any of your teammate's feelings. After all, we want our best out there against Wilson, right?!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Keep in mind that if you lose, you `won't` get to participate in that event for the Battle of the Schools.
nodes.text_bbcode: Keep in mind that if you lose, you [color=#e23b3b][i]won't[/i][/color] get to participate in that event for the Battle of the Schools.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: On the other hand, if you do `really` well, you might break a school record or two!
nodes.text_bbcode: On the other hand, if you do [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] well, you might break a school record or two!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: No questions? Great!
After lunch, you head out to the track... It's crowded with athletes stretching, warming up, and talking with each other...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hi! I'm Kimi. I think I'm like the only freshman here.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hi, I'm $Michael. You're not alone; I'm a freshman, too. Are you here for any particular event?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I guess I'm here for hurdling. I'm not really an athlete. But Keith saw me jump over a hedge this morning, so... Here I am!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: You... Jumped over a hedge?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I was in a rush! Some seniors told me that if I was late to class, I'd be `expelled.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I was in a rush! Some seniors told me that if I was late to class, I'd be [color=#3b78e2][i]expelled.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Anyway, Keith thinks that my hedge-jump means I'm destined to be a hurdler.
Keith sees you as he walks out onto the grass...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Hey! $Michael! Kimi! Glad to see you made it out here!
All the athletes gather around Keith.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Welcome, everyone, to the first day of co-ed track and field! I'm Keith, the team captain.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: First off, does anyone need to know how track works at Centerscore?

nodes.prompt: Do you need to know how track works?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Do you need to know how track works?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Alexei's not going to know what hit him!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Sweet. I knew I could count on you to back me up! Now, help me finish this poem about her.
An hour later...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: 'Be my date to the dance, and it won't be a regret. We'll sing a duet, and you'll never fret. It's no sweat...'

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: 'We'll split a baguette and I'll be in your debt...'

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: 'You'll never be upset, we'll visit Tibet and catch some fish in a fishing net.'

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Um, I'm not sure that last part made sense...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: It's a metaphor. Anyway, this is perfect.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Thanks for helping. Alexei's going to regret that he ever messed with us. Let's see him play football when I'm sitting with his sister on the fifty yard line!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Are you really going to make some poor girl think you like her just to get to Alexei?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Hey, man. These are times of `war.` We can't let ethics hold us back.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, man. These are times of [color=#e23b3b][i]war.[/i][/color] We can't let ethics hold us back.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Besides, who made you the moral police?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I'm just saying, I think this is crossing the line.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Whatever. I'll do it without your help. Thanks for nothing.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: As far as I'm concerned, everyone's a suspect.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Forget about figuring out who did it... We need to focus on getting ready.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Right. The Battle of the Schools is going to be a `lot` harder to win if they know all of our plans.
nodes.text_bbcode: Right. The Battle of the Schools is going to be a [color=#e23b3b][i]lot[/i][/color] harder to win if they know all of our plans.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I don't know how, but we need to get even...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: After the beginning of the year when that Skazz kid almost stole one of the playbooks, all the teams started keeping them in a safe in the Principal's office.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: So it had to be someone with access to the Principal's office...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't get it either. Why would `anyone` at Centerscore side with Wilson High?
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't get it either. Why would [color=#e23b3b][i]anyone[/i][/color] at Centerscore side with Wilson High?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I mean, maybe if someone had a sibling at Wilson High... Or a girlfriend there... Maybe someone got talked into it.
You grab Hector!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Whoa, get off me! What gives?!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: It's not... This isn't part of the plan!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: We've been spotted! Drop the box and run!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Way to blow our cover!

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Run!
Alexei and his friends dash off! The box falls on the ground and thousands of cockroaches swarm out!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yuck! Man, that is messed up!
Howard and Jacob come running through the back entrance.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: What happened?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We weren't even in position yet...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sorry, man. I tried to stop them, but the rookie here got in the way.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I just thought we should wait for Howard and Jacob...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, well, now we've got a million cockroaches crawling around the gym!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, you want to blame someone, blame Alexei. Blame Wilson High.
You sprint forward with Hector and grab Alexei!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Wow, you chumps actually figured out what we were up to... Too bad it's too late.
He drops his side of the box, and it tips over! Thousands of cockroaches swarm out!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Ugh! What the...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Time to get out of here!
Darren and Steve shove you aside, and they all dash off, leaving you and Hector in a pile of cockroaches.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: This is... Not ideal.
Howard and Jacob come running through the back entrance.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: What happened?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We weren't even in position yet...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sorry, man. we tried to stop them.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I guess I should have tried to grab the box instead of Alexei.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I should have realized it too. Now we've got a million cockroaches crawling around the gym.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, you want to blame someone, blame Alexei. Blame Wilson High.
You sprint forward with Hector as Alexei spots you!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: What? You guys actually caught us?
You grab the box from them, holding the lid on tight!

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: We better get out of here!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: You win this round, losers... But we'll be back.
They run off, leaving you and Hector with the box! Just then, Howard and Jacob come running up.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: What happened?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We weren't even in position yet...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Rookie here saved the day with his quick thinking!
Reputation Up

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Just at the right place at the right time.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, it was enough to stop them from letting loose these... Wait, what `are` these?
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, it was enough to stop them from letting loose these... Wait, what [color=#e23b3b][i]are[/i][/color] these?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I'm not sure I want to know...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: There's nothing grosser than the stuff my little sisters have put in my shoes over the years. I'll take a look.
Howard peeks in the box...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I... Have never seen so many cockroaches in my `life.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I... Have never seen so many cockroaches in my [color=#e23b3b][i]life.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Well, it's a good thing we got here before our school got a major infestation problem.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, but it's ridiculous that Wilson High's even trying this kind of stuff.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Jacob was patrolling the school tonight, and he saw Alexei and his goon squad pull up outside the gym.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: He's keeping an eye on them, but he's going to need all the backup he can get.
A short drive later, you meet up with Jacob.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: We better hurry. They've been in there for fifteen minutes!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Let's go check it out. Jacob, come with me. We'll go around to the back. $Michael, you and Hector go through the front. Wait for us to get into position!
You and Hector creep into the back of the gym and spot Alexei and his friends carrying a huge box.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Careful! You almost dropped them!

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: It's time to let 'em out anyway.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Yeah, but we don't want them all over us.

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Heh. Yeah. Those Centerscore creeps are going to be stuck cleaning 'em up for weeks!
Hector leans in and whispers to you...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey! Now's the time! We've got to stop them!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Are you sure? Shouldn't we wait for a sign from Howard and Jacob that they're in position?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Trust me! We `don't` want them opening up those boxes!
nodes.text_bbcode: Trust me! We [color=#e23b3b][i]don't[/i][/color] want them opening up those boxes!

nodes.text: Hector sprints forward!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I better get outside!
You race downstairs and open the door. You see Howard, Hector, and $Scott waiting for you in a car outside.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I told you $Michael would know The Code. Get in!
You jump in the car and Hector starts driving.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: So what's going on?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: But what should I do? Hmm... Maybe I'm not reading the message right... It seems like they'd tell me what to do about it...
Just then, your doorbell rings!
You answer your door to find Hector, Howard, and $Scott.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: $Michael, we've got trouble.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Oh! Right! Explosives mean we're meeting.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You forgot The Code, didn't you?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I... Yes.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: `COME ON` new guy, we don't have time for mistakes tonight!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]COME ON[/i][/color] new guy, we don't have time for mistakes tonight!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, I bet he's ready to go. Let's not waste any time.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Agh, I can't remember!
Just then, your doorbell rings!
You answer your door to find Hector, Howard, and $Scott.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: $Michael, we've got trouble.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Huh? What's going on? Are we meeting?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Didn't you get the text?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I... Yes. I got the text. And I understood it completely...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: `COME ON` new guy, we don't have time for mistakes tonight!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, I bet he's ready to go. Let's not waste any time.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I'm spamming this out to every message board in the state!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Okay, that should do it! Now we just wait for tonight...
That night, you go with $Scott, Hector, Jacob, and Howard to Wilson High...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I don't believe it... It really worked!
The football field is crowded with people dressed as knights, princesses, and wizards!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: For the last time, you and your horses and your lady need to get out of here!

nodes.speaker: Knight
nodes.text: I've told thee afore. We were invited to the annual Centerfield gathering!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: 'Centerfield'? This must be some lame prank! Look, you crazy weirdos need to get out of here before the football team is disqualified!

nodes.speaker: Knight
nodes.text: That's no way to talk to my lady!

nodes.speaker: Knight
nodes.text: I must say, I'm rather outraged by this entire event. Your costumes are wretched at best, this field is barren of whimsy, and disappointment abounds.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Kittens? `Kittens?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Kittens? [color=#e23b3b][i]Kittens?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Everyone loves kittens!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Whatever, it's too late!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Not bad.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Good, because we're out of time.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Awesome! But... Who's going to be the evil knight?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Oh, that should be easy enough. Just tell them he goes by the name 'Alexei'!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: All right, done!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Whatever, it's too late! I'm going with something everyone loves... Food.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: That's the bell! Hurry, how do we end this?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We need to promise them something.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I got it. We will have...

options.label: A guest appearance by an evil knight.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Perfect!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: A feast? I don't know if that's enough...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: No time! No time!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay, that works.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Umm...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: How about... 'A good time.'

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Not great... But okay.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Then what? How do we get them to show up? We've got to promise them something.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: How about, 'Please join us for...'

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That's good. Not great, but good enough.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I love it!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Doesn't sound very nerdy, but let's go with it.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Uhhh...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Okay, I'll just start with... 'Hey...'

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: What's going on? Don't we have to get to class soon?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Sure, but before we can go to class, we've got a higher priority thing called revenge!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: We're posting on all the local 'Ogres and Elves' message boards.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: 'Ogres and Elves'?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: It's this fantasy role playing game that all the nerds here are totally into. You know, with swords, knights, monsters, and stuff.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Anyway, we're posting that there's a huge convention tonight at Wilson High on the football field.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: They've got a big game scheduled for tonight. Let's see if they can play with an angry mob wielding swords and lances on the fifty yard line!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We just need the right wording...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: But we've got to hurry. $Michael's right... It's almost time for class. Okay, how should we start this off?

nodes.prompt: How should we start this off?

menu.title: Think fast!
menu.text: How should we start this off?

nodes.text: You hold your position... Until you see Hector running by.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What are you doing standing around? We've got to get to the library!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Didn't you get the text? Fireworks are an explosive, that means to meet up! Alligators are green, so that means we're meeting at the library.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I must have gotten mixed up...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, come on, we've got to hurry!
You head to the library ten minutes later and find $Scott, Howard, and Jacob crowded around a computer.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I'm comin' guys!
You rush to the library...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I'm here! Where's Alexei? What are they doing to the library?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Whoa! Chill, man.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: The code meant to `meet` at the library... Not that the library was getting attacked.
nodes.text_bbcode: The code meant to [color=#e23b3b][i]meet[/i][/color] at the library... Not that the library was getting attacked.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Oh. I guess I got mixed up.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Don't worry about it. We've got something big going on.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I'm comin' guys!
You rush to the library and find the guys waiting for you...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Dude, you figured out the text!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Good work, new guy.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Alligators in the library? Does that mean we're opening a zoo?
Suddenly, you see Hector running by.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What are you doing standing around? We've got to get to the library!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Didn't you get the text? Fireworks are an explosive, that means to meet up! Alligators are green, so that means we're meeting at the library.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Sorry, I couldn't figure it out.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, come on, we've got to hurry!
You head to the library and find $Scott, Howard, and Jacob crowded around a computer.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: He's right. This is a disaster.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: First they go after the playbooks, now this.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: They really don't fight fair! Who do they think they are?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: All I know is, next time, we're not just waiting for Wilson High to make the first move... We're going to show them they can't push us around.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Thank you!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Are you sure? 'Cause it sounds kind of... Awesome.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: `We. Are. Not. Using. These!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]We. Are. Not. Using. These![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Look, the point is, Wilson High sabotaged our team. We can't take this lying down.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I mean, come on... Short shorts and crop tops? You might get a lot more people watching.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Yeah, I think this might be an improvement...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: We. Are. Not. Using. These!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Stop being such jerks!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Okay, okay.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Yeah, calm down.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Look, you guys are missing the point. Wilson High came into our school and sabotaged our team.

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Just wait till you see what we did to the other jerseys!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Other jerseys? What does he mean?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Wait... Maybe... The girls' team?
The guys run into the girls' locker room.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Are you sure we're allowed to be here?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, we're clear. None of the girls' teams practice this late.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Let's just find the jerseys and--
The guys turn the corner and nearly run into a barely-clothed Kim!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Eeek! You guys are `so` dead! What are you doing in here?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Eeek! You guys are [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] dead! What are you doing in here?!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: We were just checking on the jerseys! Wilson High was lurking around here. We weren't trying to... Do... Anything.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Besides, we thought everyone would be gone by now!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Ugh. I was here late working on my free throws... What are you saying happened to the jerseys?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: We don't know... Let's see 'em.
Kim goes to her locker and opens it up. She pulls out her uniform...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: It's...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: It's...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: `Tiny!` They shrunk our uniforms! We can't play in these! We'd be half-naked!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Tiny![/i][/color] They shrunk our uniforms! We can't play in these! We'd be half-naked!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: So? What do I care if you dress me up as a lizard?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Maybe you'll care when we tie you up and leave you on the Wilson High side of town!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Oh man! You'd never live that down!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: No! Not that! Alexei would never let me come on another mission again!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: So unless you want to end up humiliated, you better start talking.

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Okay, okay! We were sabotaging the boys' basketball jerseys.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Wait... 'We'? Is someone else here?!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Maybe I should go get the Lyle suit...

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: ...Darren's in the locker room right now grabbing the jerseys...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Quick! We've got to stop him!
You and the guys sprint into the locker room and catch Darren stuffing the basketball jerseys into a bag!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Drop the jerseys!

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Urk!
Darren drops them and runs out the back!
You race to the doorway in time to see Darren and Steve driving off. Darren opens the window and calls back...

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: My parents? Please. They went to Wilson High too! They'll probably give me a car!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Oh.
Just then, you see Darren sprinting out of the boys' locker room, his arms full of jerseys!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Code red! Code red! He's got backup!

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Steve, what happened?!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Abort the plan! Just take the jerseys! Run!
Steve breaks free and joins him, sprinting to their getaway car. You and the others run after them, but they get away before you can catch them!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: They got the uniforms!
As they drive off, Darren opens the window and calls back...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Good. Don't worry, we've got something in the works. You'll know when we need you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: See you around, $Michael.
When the guys leave, Sierra runs up to you.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Wow! Were you just talking to Howard and Hector?! They're two of the most popular guys in school!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Uh, yeah, I guess so. It sounds like they want my help defending Centerscore from Wilson High.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: That's so cool!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Heh. Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Immature? `Immature?` You think this is immature? This is about defending our school! This is about pride, honor, and glory!
nodes.text_bbcode: Immature? [color=#e23b3b][i]Immature?[/i][/color] You think this is immature? This is about defending our school! This is about pride, honor, and glory!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: This is about stealing their lunches and replacing them with bags of spiders!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay, so it is a `little` immature... But hey, it's fun.
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, so it is a [color=#e23b3b][i]little[/i][/color] immature... But hey, it's fun.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Besides, Wilson High always goes after us. If we don't defend ourselves, we'll be sitting ducks. You saw how they went after our playbooks!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Look, new guy, Skazz `came into our school and grabbed our playbooks.` And they egged $Kelly and Peter! Wilson High doesn't fight fair.
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, new guy, Skazz [color=#e23b3b][i]came into our school and grabbed our playbooks.[/i][/color] And they egged $Kelly and Peter! Wilson High doesn't fight fair.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And those dirty cheaters almost got away with it. That's the kind of thing that gets my blood boiling. But maybe you don't care.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Hey, I didn't say `that.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, I didn't say [color=#e23b3b][i]that.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: After the stunt they tried to pull with the playbooks, they deserve some payback.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: We could use another guy like you.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Just let me know what to do.
The next day, you're heading to lunch when you see $Scott and Jacob talking to a group of guys.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: $Michael! Hey! Just the guy we wanted to see.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You're the guy who chased after Skazz, right?

nodes.text: Sure! Glad I could help!
Later that day, you're walking across school when Mona runs up to you!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: You! You're $Michael, right?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Um, yeah... Who are you?

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: I'm Mona, darling, the crown jewel of the Centerscore Theater department! I heard you've been helping some students out!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Uh... Well... I guess...

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Well... We need help!

nodes.text: Thanks so much, $Michael! You're the best!

nodes.speaker: Amanda

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: What? No. I thought I was helping you...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Well, your kind of help makes me feel bad...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Right. Exactly like that.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Maybe you should have some lizards on the poster?

nodes.speaker: Amanda

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Right. Well, then, maybe you could...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Thanks! You're so sweet, $Michael!
