nodes.text: Not school-themed? What do you mean? Everything on the poster is cute, and everyone at Centerscore is cute! Are you saying we're not cute?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Oh, no. I didn't mean that. We're cute. I was just thinking...
After school, you're heading home when you see Peter with the girls' tennis team.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Hey, Peter! I haven't seen you around lately. What are you doing with the girls' tennis team?

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Hey! Yeah, I'm helping them out. The ball machine broke, so I'm hitting balls to them.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: We could really use someone else on the second court...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I'm your man.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Great! You can use one of the spare rackets. Go hit balls to Jane. She really needs help working on her backhand volleys.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Hmph! Like I need your help.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Just give me something to hit!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Okay, I'm on it. Backhand volleys coming up.
You volley back and forth with Jane like a pro!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Oof! Not bad!
After a long hour of practice...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Wow! That was really helpful! I think I actually improved!
Reputation Up

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Nothing to it.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Well, thanks for helping us out, $Michael!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: No problem.
You try to hit the balls to Jane, but instead they go across the court, hitting Peter, Mallika, and the rest of the team!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: This is `not` working out. The only ball you've managed to get near me hit me right in the head!
nodes.text_bbcode: This is [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] working out. The only ball you've managed to get near me hit me right in the head!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: It would appear I'm surprisingly bad at this.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Just get out of here.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Can you imagine being a freshman and having no one know who you are?

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: No, dear. I've always been popular. Even when no one knew who I was, they still knew that they needed to know me.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Mona

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Well, like, look at this guy...
Hannah stares at you...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: A nobody.

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: I see your point, darling.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Geez... No one knows who I am... I'd better work on my reputation!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry, I don't think I've heard of you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You've really got to go out and meet people, $Michael. Or else you're totally going to get lost in the shuffle here.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Maybe I should work on my reputation...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Anyway, I've got to tell someone... Sam and her cousin are going to set me up with a really cute guy for the Kiss and Make Up Dance!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: There's a dance?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: At the end of the Battle of the Schools, there's a big dance with Wilson High where we're all supposed to forgive and forget.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Don't worry. I'm sure you won't have any trouble finding a date.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Um, yeah. I guess `some` girls don't care about popularity...
nodes.text_bbcode: Um, yeah. I guess [color=#3b78e2][i]some[/i][/color] girls don't care about popularity...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh, just kidding, new guy.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I hope I can find a date for the dance!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: $Michael's on the track team.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's kind of a stretch.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Uh, yeah, my first day didn't go so well.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Hey! $Michael! Got a sec?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Sure! What's up?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Well, keep this on the down-low... But I was walking past the faculty break room, and I overheard two of your teachers talking about you!
They said you're getting a %d.%d GPA!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Sweet! All that studying is really paying off.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Just make sure you keep that up... If you drop below a 2.5,  you won't be able to play in the Battle of the Schools.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: And you know how much the track team is counting on you.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Of course! I won't let you down.
They said you were having some trouble... You're getting a %d.%d GPA!

nodes.text: You'd better! If you get below a 2.5, you won't be able to play in the Battle of the Schools!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Come on, man! The team's really counting on you.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I know, I know! I'll get my act together.

You're walking down the hall when Ms. Lee sidles up next to you!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: $Michael.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Oh! Uh, Ms. Lee! Hey!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: We must speak immediately. I just got a look at your current grades...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Someone's got an awards banquet taquito with their name on it! And that taquito is named $Michael!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: A friendly counselor reminder... All you need is a 3.5 for Honor Roll and a 3.75 for Dean's List!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Uh... I'll keep that in mind! Thanks for letting me know, Ms. Lee!
They're not bad at all! You're getting a %d.%d GPA!

format.pattern: They're not bad at all! You're getting a %d.%d GPA!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I've seen plenty of kids fail their finals and drop below a 2.5 in the last week of school right before the Battle of the Schools!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: You don't want to do that. It's a shame not everyone makes Honor Roll because the taquitos at the academic awards banquet really put the yum in scrumptious!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Um, Ms. Lee, there's no 'y' in...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: If you really hit the books hard, who knows? Maybe you could turn things around... You only need a 3.5 for Honor Roll!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Uh... I'll keep that in mind! Thanks for letting me know, Ms. Lee!
You're really stinking it up! You've got a %d.%d GPA!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: If you don't raise that to a 2.5...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I know, I know... I won't be able to compete in the Battle of the Schools!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Your future is important, $Michael! Next week is finals week... That's a good chance to raise your GPA...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I had high hopes for you, young man. I thought you'd get at least a 3.5 and that we'd be eating taquitos together at the academic awards banquet... Now I'm just hoping you make 2.5.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: If you do that, maybe we'll share a cafeteria tamale or something. They're not nearly as tasty, but better than nothing!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I'll do my best, Ms. Lee...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Okay! Grades should be a priority!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Whoa! A wild panda's diet is 99% based on bamboo! Weird!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: How do you feel?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Let's go. I think improving out on the track's more important than grades right now.

nodes.text: All right, $Michael! Now you'll have the strength to throw that javelin for miles!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Sweet!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: This is great!

nodes.speaker: Keith

nodes.speaker: Michael

On Thursday, you meet up with Keith...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hey! $Michael! Glad you could make it...

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Sure!

nodes.text: You're going to be hurdling soon... I was thinking it might help if I show you some of the jumping exercises I do...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Really? Cool!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: The thing is, in order for this to work, you've got to be pretty conditioned. Let's see if you can keep up!
Keith takes you through a half-hour routine of jumping drills...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Where's your badger? You weren't trying to get out of our bet, were you?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Wait... Sorry, never mind, Colt's the one I meant to congratulate. You didn't actually break any records...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Um... But... You do have a record-breaking smile!
The song ends, and Allison pulls away.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Thanks for the dance. You really cheered me up!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: No problem.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: But now I better get back to my brother and his friends. They're not going to be too happy if they see me hanging around `another` Centerscore guy.
nodes.text_bbcode: But now I better get back to my brother and his friends. They're not going to be too happy if they see me hanging around [color=#3b78e2][i]another[/i][/color] Centerscore guy.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Oh, right.
Allison turns and heads off with a wave. You turn back to the dance floor...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You... You think so?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Yeah! A guy would have to be a total dirt bag to do something so horrible to a sweet girl like you.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That's... That's so sweet. I guess not all Centerscore High guys are jerks.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Heh, thanks.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: A joke? Breaking my heart was a `joke?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: A joke? Breaking my heart was a [color=#3b78e2][i]joke?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Yeah, you shouldn't take it personally.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Sorry, I guess it's just not that funny to me.
Allison pushes you away and slaps you across the face!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Ow!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: All you Centerscore guys are the same! Get away from me!
Allison turns and runs.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: That... could have gone better.
You turn back to the dance floor as the slow song ends...
You head over to where the girl is standing...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Would you... Um... Like to dance?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Um, sure. Hey, I know you, don't I? Weren't you at Wilson High the night of the big prank?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Yeah, you let me use your towel. That was really cool of you.
You put your arms around Allison and the two of you begin swaying...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Is something... Um... Wrong?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: This great guy asked me to the Kiss and Make Up Dance. He was so sweet, he wrote me a poem and everything!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: But he said he had to borrow a car to go get my corsage...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: So I let him borrow my brother's car, but when he brought it back this morning, it was painted `bright green` with a lizard on it!
nodes.text_bbcode: So I let him borrow my brother's car, but when he brought it back this morning, it was painted [color=#3b78e2][i]bright green[/i][/color] with a lizard on it!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: And then he... He... He said he wasn't going to take me to the dance, and he only asked me so he could play that trick on my brother!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Oh no! `Allison` is the girl who Jacob was messing with?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh no! [color=#e23b3b][i]Allison[/i][/color] is the girl who Jacob was messing with?!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Just... Why... How could someone do something like that?

menu.text: How could someone do something like that?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Lauren...
You lean in to give Lauren a kiss... But she pulls away!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Not here, $Michael! Not in front of both schools!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: But I thought you were over that?

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: At the Kiss and Make Up Dance, I am. But the dance is over, and I have a reputation to re-build.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: We can still see each other... Just in secret... Like before.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Now, I should go... I'm going to pretend to say something mean just so no one catches on.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Okay...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Ahem... Maybe if you weren't such an ugly, disgusting Lizard, $Michael!
Lauren slams her car door shut and drives off!
Yikes! Looks like $Michael and Lauren are headed for some trouble.
A slow song comes on...

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: All right, ladies and gentlemen! It's the first slow song of the night... And you know what that means!

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Since this is the Kiss and Make Up Dance, every girl out there's got to grab a guy from your rival school and dance!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Guess we'll have to keep making up as we dance...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Heh. Guess so...
You and Lauren dance together close...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: I'm sorry, too.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: You are? For what?

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: For leaving you at the restaurant. For confronting you at your school. For changing our relationship status to `Never will be in a relationship with.`
nodes.text_bbcode: For leaving you at the restaurant. For confronting you at your school. For changing our relationship status to [color=#3b78e2][i]Never will be in a relationship with.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Getting that trophy and seeing it in that trophy room meant so much to me that I saw what you did as an act against `me,` not against Wilson.
nodes.text_bbcode: Getting that trophy and seeing it in that trophy room meant so much to me that I saw what you did as an act against [color=#3b78e2][i]me,[/i][/color] not against Wilson.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: But when everyone got angry with me for dating you, I stopped caring about the stupid trophy.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: I mean, it's hard to care about winning for your school when everyone at your school thinks you're some kind of traitor. Even people I thought were my friends...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: It made me realize... I just want to be with you, $Michael.
Someone taps you on your shoulder...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I know it's girl's choice... And I know you guys actually have some making up to do, but I'd like a dance with my Wilson High rival...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: She's all yours...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Come find me after.
You and Lauren separate, and she starts dancing with Keith.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: What do I do now?
That's when you see a familiar-looking girl alone in the corner...
Later that night, the DJ plays the last song and the music slowly fades away...

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Well, kids, that was the last song. Have a good night!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: $Michael, this was fun.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I had fun, too.
Later...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Thanks for walking me to my car. Very gentlemanly of you.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I knew that the trophy room was important to you. I didn't realize `how` important, but I could have told the guys to prank something else.
nodes.text_bbcode: I knew that the trophy room was important to you. I didn't realize [color=#e23b3b][i]how[/i][/color] important, but I could have told the guys to prank something else.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: That means a lot to me.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: It was immature...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Actually, it sounded like we deserved it. I mean, we `stole your playbooks.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Actually, it sounded like we deserved it. I mean, we [color=#3b78e2][i]stole your playbooks.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: This isn't about maturity. It's about being considerate of my feelings. You knew that the trophy room was important to me, $Michael...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I know. I did. I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: I figured if I brought this, it might mean something to you...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: It does.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Nice lizard.
You finish your push-up amidst a barrage of cheers!

nodes.text: $Michael wins!

nodes.text: I don't even care about this stupid thing.
He tosses the lizard on the ground, turns, and leaves the dance.
Lauren picks up her lizard...

nodes.text: Thanks, Slowpoke. That was really cool of you.
Alexei stands up and grabs the lizard.

nodes.text: I'll be taking this so I can go throw it in a dumpster.
As he turns, Colt stands in his way...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: What do you want?

nodes.text: Oh, it turns out you're going to give the lizard back to the girl.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.text: Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Alexei

Lauren picks up her lizard...

nodes.text: Thanks, Colt. That was really cool of you.

nodes.text: Back off, blondie.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Easy, easy. I'm... here for someone else.

Alexei falls over!

nodes.text: Come on, $Michael! One more to beat him!
Alexei barely manages to do another push-up...

Alexei does another push-up, but on the way back up...

Alexei does another `strong` push-up...

nodes.text: I guess I'll just... Watch from the stands...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: As much as I want to wipe Wilson High off the face of the planet, grades are too important to be neglected.
You sit in the stands and watch the track meet...

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Wilson has absolutely demolished Centerscore on the track today.

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Unfortunate for Centerscore as they really needed a win here.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: This is terrible...
Afterwards, you join the team as they huddle around Keith...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I'm sorry, guys. I really let everyone...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Don't, $Michael. We really thought you were going to be there for us... And you weren't...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I know you're going to give it your best!
You see your family cheering for you from the stands!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Make us proud, $Michael!

nodes.speaker: Aunt Martha
nodes.text: You can do it, $Michael!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Go, cuz!

nodes.speaker: Gayle
nodes.text: Look at the unicorn I drew for you!

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Welcome everyone to the track and field meet for the Battle of the Schools!

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Our first event of the meet is the javelin-throw!
You see Steph, the Wilson javelin-thrower, warming up.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Do you have any classes with $Kelly?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Yeah, we've got science class together.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: That's nice. I'll let your mom know. It'll make her happy that you're getting to see your cousin.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: I told her it was better for you and Gayle to stay here in Centerscore with me when she moved after the divorce. Much better than making you two move.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: How are your other classes going?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Oh, man. It was only the first day, and we already had a pop quiz.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: How'd it go?

nodes.speaker: Gayle
nodes.text: Daaaad, I hate that nickname!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Right, right, kiddo. How was kindergarten?

nodes.speaker: Gayle
nodes.text: I didn't like it! Jimmy took my marker and then I knocked him down and the teacher made me go to time out!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Maybe someone needs to...

options.label: Have a talk with this 'Jimmy' kid.

nodes.text: On Wednesday afternoon, you meet up with Sierra...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Hey, is it just me, or do we not have any class scheduled for this afternoon?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: You don't know about this? It's free study! You do know about free study, right?

nodes.prompt: You do know about free study, right?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: You do know about free study, right?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Have some faith in yourself!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: I'm going to get some nachos.
Jessica and Zach head off to the snack bar.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: So, you're a real pool shark, huh?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Oh, I wouldn't say that! I just know a couple tricks. I guess my dad and I have been spending a lot of time together lately.
As you're talking, a group of college guys come up.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Hey, we're taking over this table.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Yeah. Scram, kids.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: That's okay. We just finished our game. It's all yours.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Actually, on second thought, maybe you should stay with us.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: What's wrong? Think this guy's going to cry if you leave him? Come on, ditch him and come with us!
On one side of the saloon, you spot a photographer taking pictures of families and couples.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Hey, it's one of those silly old-time photographs! Don't you want to take a picture for your Popularity Updater page?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: We should definitely get a picture! But... I don't think Taylor would like me posting this picture.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: She says the new cheerleaders have to appear single to draw as many guys to the games as we can.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: But I'd still love to get a picture with you!
You and Sierra get in line...

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: Pick out your costumes, and I'll snap your picture when you're ready!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Okay, so what costumes should we wear? They've got everything... Fake guns, cowboy hats, vests, boots...

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: I know! Why don't you pick out something for me, and I'll pick out something for you?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Heh. Okay.
Sierra disappears behind a curtain rummaging through the men's costumes as you turn to the women's costumes.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: What should I have Sierra dress up in?

nodes.prompt: What should I have Sierra dress up as?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What should I have Sierra dress up as?

nodes.text: Sam and $ZOE head off to class.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: That was weird... I wonder what's going on with Sierra.
Saturday night, you go to the football game to watch Sierra cheer. She spots you in the crowd and runs over!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Hey, $Michael! Thank you so much for coming! It means a lot to me.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Sure, no problem. Is it okay for you to be over here?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Sure. The game's almost over, and it looks like we're going to lose. We'd need a miracle touchdown to win.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Oh, okay. Look, I thought about what I said before, and I think you should...

options.label: Go with Zach. I'll go alone.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: So much for being inconspicuous... That text was probably from Lauren...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: 'I'm in the back, Slowpoke. Get up here before you draw attention to yourself.'
You slink toward the back of the theater...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Psst... Hey, stranger.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Psst... Hey!
You sit down next to Lauren and put on your 3D glasses...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: This is so cool!

nodes.speaker: Doctor Awesome
nodes.text: Piratica! Will you never release your vow of vengeance upon me after I botched your operation?

nodes.speaker: Piratica
nodes.text: Never, Doctor Awesome! Your kind of malpractice not only cost me my vision, but also my baby!

nodes.speaker: Doctor Awesome
nodes.text: You mean... Our baby?

nodes.speaker: Piratica
nodes.text: Avast ye! You'll have eternity to think about what ye did after this dynamite blasts ye into parrrticles!

nodes.speaker: Doctor Awesome
nodes.text: Holy Moons of Neptune! Curse you, Piratica!
An explosion startles the crowd!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Wow! This 3D is intense!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Psst... Tell you what, `starting now` first one to flinch has to refer to the other one as 'Doctor Awesome' for the rest of the night!
nodes.text_bbcode: Psst... Tell you what, [color=#3b78e2][i]starting now[/i][/color] first one to flinch has to refer to the other one as 'Doctor Awesome' for the rest of the night!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Heh! You're on!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Okay... I just have to stay relaxed... No flinching!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Oh... You're not upset that you had to leave it for me?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Nah. A fight broke out there about a girl suspected of dating a guy from Wilson. I think now more than ever it's best to keep us secret.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: I'm glad we got to come here...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Look! According to the menu, there's a penalty for accidentally dropping your bread in the fondue pot.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Women have to kiss the person on their right, and men have to buy another round of bread.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Looks like I'm the person on your right...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Do you even `have` enough money for extra rounds of bread?
nodes.text_bbcode: Do you even [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] enough money for extra rounds of bread?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Heh. I don't think I'm going to need it. But I am looking forward to all these kisses...
After ordering, the waitress brings out a pot of melted cheese for you and Lauren.
Lauren goes first, skewering a piece of bread and skillfully dipping it into the pot.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Yum! Your turn, Slowpoke.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Uh-oh. I may have gotten in over my head. Looks like I have to dip my bread in at an angle in order to keep it on the skewer...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't care about any team or glory or winning or any of that jock-garbage. I'm only doing this because I get out of detention for helping out with the Battle of the Schools.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And as a bonus I get to see my girlfriend, Sammy, running around in tiny shorts...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I've gotta go, Dad!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Great... With Dad here, it's going to be hard not to be nervous!
You run over to the hundred meter dash area, where Keith and Colt are waiting...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Remember, it's a sprint. So think `fast.` And don't worry about Colt, just run `your` race.
nodes.text_bbcode: Remember, it's a sprint. So think [color=#e23b3b][i]fast.[/i][/color] And don't worry about Colt, just run [color=#e23b3b][i]your[/i][/color] race.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Whatever.
You toe the starting line, your muscles poised...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Go!
Later, you meet up with the team...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Nice job out there today, everyone. See you next practice...
You get changed and meet Sam near the pole-vaulting area...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Here, take this pole. Now, let's see what you've got.
Just as you're about to make your run, you spot Lauren standing in a secluded area next to the bleachers!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: What's she doing here?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, this is unbelievable! That Wilson High girl is here! Keith!
Keith runs over...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The captain of the Wilson High track team's watching our practice!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I'm sure she's...
You toe the line, your muscles poised...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Okay, I just have to jump over the hurdles and sprint in between them...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Ready... Go!
You explode forward!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Here we go... The first hurdle! I should...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: You're officially our secret weapon!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Thanks, Keith.
As you jog over to the javelin area, you see $Kelly in the bleachers!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Hey, $Michael!
You jog over...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Hi, cuz! Thanks for coming!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: What's family for, right?!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Heh!
You return to the javelin area...
You pick up your javelin... You test the weight of it in your hand and focus...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Okay... Let's see if I can remember Dex's tips...

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Come say hi!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh, and don't drop the baton. When I dropped it last time, Sammy stopped talking to me for a week.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: A week?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah. It might have had something to do with the French foreign exchange hottie that started flirting with me, calling me `Le Colt` all the time, but I can't be sure.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah. It might have had something to do with the French foreign exchange hottie that started flirting with me, calling me [color=#e23b3b][i]Le Colt[/i][/color] all the time, but I can't be sure.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So... Let's both try our best to keep Sammy happy... Got it?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Gulp!
You get set at your position for the relay...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Ready, Sam... Go!
Sam leads things off!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Good start!
You run over to the team...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Everyone, keep your heads up! You did superb out there today...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Especially $Michael! That was sensational hurdling!
Record Broken!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Congratulations! We definitely want you in this event for the Battle of the Schools!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: And congratulations to $Michael! You didn't break my hurdling record, but you're in this event for the Battle of the Schools!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: And $Michael, don't worry. Not everyone's a hurdler...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: The Battle of the Schools `is` getting closer. I expect everyone to be in prime shape.
nodes.text_bbcode: The Battle of the Schools [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] getting closer. I expect everyone to be in prime shape.

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: You see, one of the big events in the Battle of the Schools is an `Act-Off`... An acting showdown between us and the Wilson theater club!
nodes.text_bbcode: You see, one of the big events in the Battle of the Schools is an [color=#3b78e2][i]Act-Off[/i][/color]... An acting showdown between us and the Wilson theater club!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Everything's ready for our imminent victory... Except for the costumes! Our order somehow 'mysteriously' got re-routed to Tibet!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Of course we suspect Wilson High had something to do with it... But now we need new costumes!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Everyone who can help is gathering in the auditorium after school. I've got another errand to run before. Hope to see you there!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I guess it couldn't hurt to show up...
A little while later, you meet Brendan, Sam, and $ZOE with the rest of the theater group.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You got talked into helping too, huh? $ZOE made me come help.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, Sam, don't be so fussy.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Heh.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey, everyone. Thanks for helping. Mona's out trying to get someone to make the sets. I'll work with you guys on the costumes.
Brendan pulls out a costume box, fabric, and props.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Now, the main thing to remember is that it's a period piece. We can't use anything modern.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Now let's get started. Mona scheduled our first dress rehearsal for tonight, so we really need to get this right!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Authentic peasant costume, $Michael! Mona's going to love it.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Thanks! You just have to bunch up the fabric at the top, and you can make a matching parasol!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know how that works, but it's amazing!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: With your help, we'll be done in no time!
After a few hours of work...

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Eeek! This is `ahmazing!` $Michael, this is absolutely perfect!
nodes.text_bbcode: Eeek! This is [color=#3b78e2][i]ahmazing![/i][/color] $Michael, this is absolutely perfect!

nodes.text: Reputation Up

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: No problem!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Um, $Michael, what are you doing with that silver paint? What's going on?!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Trust me, I have a vision...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I see your vision... And Mona is `not` going to go for this...
nodes.text_bbcode: I see your vision... And Mona is [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] going to go for this...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: What? You don't like the flashing buttons on the back of the dress?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: They shouldn't be there... And the dress shouldn't be metallic silver!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Are you making Mona a robot?! You can't do that! The play takes place in a `cottage!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you making Mona a robot?! You can't do that! The play takes place in a [color=#3b78e2][i]cottage![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: But... My vision... Let's let Mona decide, okay?
Later that night, Mona returns...

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Eeek! This is `terrible!` What were you thinking? We'd be better off performing `without` costumes!
nodes.text_bbcode: Eeek! This is [color=#3b78e2][i]terrible![/i][/color] What were you thinking? We'd be better off performing [color=#3b78e2][i]without[/i][/color] costumes!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It was all $Michael's idea!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Thanks for all your help, but I think this might be faster `without` you.
nodes.text_bbcode: Thanks for all your help, but I think this might be faster [color=#e23b3b][i]without[/i][/color] you.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Sorry...
Just then, a slow song comes on...

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: All right, ladies and gentlemen! It's time for the first slow song of the night... And you know what that means!

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Since this is the Kiss and Make Up Dance, every girl out there's got to grab a guy from your rival school and dance!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Someone from Wilson? This is going to be awkward.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Oh, it'll be kind of fun.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: But how am I going to find someone to dance with?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: I'll pick someone for you.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Why don't you dance with that girl in the corner? She looks like she's having a pretty bad night.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Hey... She looks familiar...
Just then, a guy taps on Sierra's shoulder...

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Would you like to dance?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Uh... Sure. See you after the dance, $Michael.
You spot Sierra standing with the other cheerleaders as Taylor is shouting at her!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Zach says you totally stood him up!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I wanted to say I'm sorry, Lauren...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: For what?
Meanwhile in the theater, the 'Act-Off' is taking place! Mona stands in front of a gorgeous set of a quaint little cottage....
Meanwhile, in the parking lot... A crowd of nerds has gathered for the Robot Deathmatch. Amanda is setting up her poster nearby...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Go robots! Yay Spirit Club!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: There's no cheering in engineering!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But they rhyme!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Boltar is a machine! It doesn't need support!

nodes.speaker: Boris
nodes.text: Yes it does! There is no way your little battery here can ever defeat Annihilatron!
The two robots circle each other on the field of battle...
When suddenly, Boltar turns toward Amanda and the poster...
That afternoon, everyone from both schools is gathered together in the gym. Judge Tigh walks onto the stage...

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Well, folks, we've tabulated the results from all the different games today.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: This has been the closest Battle of the Schools in recent memory. Both schools played extremely well.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: But in the end, there can only be one winner. And that winner...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I never thought $Michael would be `such` a genius.
nodes.text_bbcode: I never thought $Michael would be [color=#3b78e2][i]such[/i][/color] a genius.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Also, I believe he enjoyed the taquitos at the awards banquet and that's a sign of good taste.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Funny thing, lately every time I try to talk to him, I end up getting distracted by something...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: $Michael and I ate taquitos together at the awards banquet.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: He's going places, that one. And not because of his grades... But because I'm positive he enjoyed those taquitos. He's got good taste!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: He got to participate in the Battle of the Schools, but he never really impressed me academically.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: We never got to eat taquitos together at the awards banquet, and that's something he'll always regret.
We hope you enjoyed playing 'Surviving High School!'

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Let's play something else now...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: How about skeeball?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Sounds good!
You head over to the row of skeeball games...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Looks like we get tickets based on how well we do.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: I wonder if we can get a good prize with our tickets...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Probably not... Unless you're really in need of an eraser shaped like a ladybug.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: My eraser collection `is` somewhat depleted...
nodes.text_bbcode: My eraser collection [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] somewhat depleted...

nodes.text: You and Lauren put your quarters in for skeeball. Lauren goes first and rolls her ball right into the middle circle!

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: That's worth twenty-five tickets! If you do can match me, we'll have enough to get something awesome!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: No pressure!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Oh man! The tire dash! I've just got to make sure to alternate my feet!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I'll start with my...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: All that's left is the rope swing! I have to time when I let go, so that I land on the platform on the other side...
You grab the rope and swing out!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Don't let go...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I don't know what happened...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Listen, $Michael, I know what I saw when you chased after that guy with our playbooks. I `know` you've got talent.
nodes.text_bbcode: Listen, $Michael, I know what I saw when you chased after that guy with our playbooks. I [color=#e23b3b][i]know[/i][/color] you've got talent.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: But I did terrible...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I've seen worse, believe me. All this means is that we'll just have to work a little harder to find the event that works for you...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Unfortunately, you had the slowest time... So... You'll be doing everyone's laundry...
Colt walks by and tosses a sweaty towel at your head...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Thanks, Detergent.
You're changing in the locker room when Colt walks by...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Hey, Colt, I think we're sprinting against each other today...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Here, take this pole. Now, let's see what you've got.
Just as you're about to make your run, you spot Lauren standing in a secluded area next to the bleachers!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: What's she doing here?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, this is unbelievable! That Wilson High girl is here! Keith!
Keith runs over...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The captain of the Wilson High track team's watching our practice!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I'm sure she's...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Keith can get a little carried away some times with evaluating talent.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Personally, unless I saw you using a tree branch to vault over another freshman, I wouldn't let you even touch a pole.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But it's Keith's call.
You get changed and meet Sam near the pole-vaulting area...
You head over to the hurdling area... And find Kimi lying on the ground holding her leg!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: $Michael! Help! I don't know what to do!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I was just warming up and my leg starting cramping...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: So... Why don't you tell Keith?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You don't understand! I've been totally sucking! He'll kick me off the team, I know it! And if I let the team down, my life will be `ruined!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You don't understand! I've been totally sucking! He'll kick me off the team, I know it! And if I let the team down, my life will be [color=#3b78e2][i]ruined![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I don't think it's that bad... I think you should...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Got it!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Now I have to sprint and hand it off to Colt!
You grab the baton tight!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Now I just have to sprint for the finish line!
That night, you go to the big party at $Scott's house...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Wow! This is huge! Everyone's here!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh man, I still can't forget their faces when we pulled that prank off! Those Wilson losers had no idea what hit them!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ooo, I love this song! Everybody watch me dance! Wooooo!

nodes.speaker: Trev
nodes.text: Hey guys! If you go outside, Spike's totally going to set his arm on fire! It's gonna be awesome!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I just got a text from Lauren!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: 'slowpoke, what are you up to tonight? want to do something?'
You step outside as Spike walks past you, dripping wet, the sleeve of his sweatshirt singed completely off!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Oh, man, this party shreds!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: This party's so much fun! I don't know if Lauren wants to be here with all these Centerscore people, though... What should I text her?

options.label: at Cntrscor party. u shld come!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Okay, everyone! Our first official practice is Friday of next week!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Work out in your spare time! I want you loose and ready to go!
You win easily!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: $Michael, that's what I like to see. You didn't break the school record, but that was pretty fast!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Congratulations! You're in this event for the Battle of the Schools!
You fall on your face!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Oof!
Colt breezes across the line ahead of you...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Don't beat yourself up about it, $Michael. There are other events we can try you out in. You're just not a sprinter, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Okay, everyone! Battle of the Schools is `next week!` Be prepared!
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, everyone! Battle of the Schools is [color=#e23b3b][i]next week![/i][/color] Be prepared!

nodes.text: Colt crosses the finish line...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: That's exactly what I wanted to see!
You can hear your family cheering for you from the stands!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Atta boy!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Way to go, cuz!

nodes.speaker: Gayle
nodes.text: Yay, $Michael!
Colt crosses the finish line...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: That's just not going to cut it at the Battle of the Schools...
You see your family's sad faces in the stands...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Well, this is the team, so all we can hope to do is get better.
Your total grade score is now %d!

format.pattern: Your total grade score is now %d!

nodes.text: Since it's week %d, that means your current GPA is %d.%d.

format.pattern: Since it's week %d, that means your current GPA is %d.%d.

nodes.text: Alexei stands up and grabs the lizard.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: I'll be taking this so I can go throw it in a dumpster.
As he turns, Colt stands in his way...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh, it turns out you're going to give the lizard back to the girl.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Whatever... I don't even want the stupid thing.
He tosses the lizard on the ground, turns, and leaves the dance.
Lauren picks up her lizard...

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Thanks, Colt. That was really cool of you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Back off, blondie.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: Easy, easy. I'm... here for someone else.

nodes.speaker: Lauren
nodes.text: By the way, thanks Slowpoke, for trying.

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Well, that's it, folks. The end of the meet!

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: See you at the closing ceremony...
You drop the baton!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: `No!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]No![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: What a terrible blunder by $Michael. This race is Wilson's all the way...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: That's what these Centerscore losers deserve! To `lose!`
nodes.text_bbcode: That's what these Centerscore losers deserve! To [color=#e23b3b][i]lose![/i][/color]

nodes.text: That night, you sit at the dinner table with your dad and little sister...

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: So, first day of school, huh? Big man on campus already?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Heh. Not yet... But I did join the track team.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Track! Attaboy! Back in my day, I used to be the fastest guy on the track team!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: How'd your first day go?
On Friday, you head over to the track for your first attempt at an event...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Hey, $Michael. Time to get you up to speed so you can break some state records in the Battle of the Schools!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: We've got a few events going on today for you to tryout for. Where do you want to start?

nodes.prompt: What event do you want to start with?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What event do you want to start with?

nodes.text: Later that night, you're about to leave school when you spot Hector, Howard, and $Scott coming toward you.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: New guy. It's time.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Huh? What's going on?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: The fire's burning through the forest! We've got to dynamite the situation `now!`
nodes.text_bbcode: The fire's burning through the forest! We've got to dynamite the situation [color=#e23b3b][i]now![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: $Scott, $Michael doesn't know The Code yet.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Oh... Right.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Jacob was patrolling the school, and he apprehended one of Alexei's goons sneaking around the gym. He needs backup NOW!
A few minutes later, you meet up with Jacob. He's holding a struggling Wilson High guy.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: So, Steve refuses to tell us what he was doing or if anyone was with him.

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: I'll never talk! Do whatever you want to me!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Oh really?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: You better tell us the truth, or we'll...

nodes.prompt: You better tell us the truth, or we'll...

options.label: Dress you up in a Lyle the Lizard costume.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: You better tell us the truth, or we'll...

nodes.text: On Thursday morning, you're at your locker when you get a text from Jacob...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: 'The alligators are in the library with the fireworks.'

menu.title: Think fast!
menu.text: The alligators are in the library with the fireworks.

nodes.text: You're at home that night when you get a text message from Hector...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: '`DYNAMITE! OUTSIDE! NOW!`'
nodes.text_bbcode: '[color=#e23b3b][i]DYNAMITE! OUTSIDE! NOW![/i][/color]'

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: That means...
At school the next day, the hallways are crowded!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: How could this happen?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: We've got to figure out who did it!
You fight your way toward Jacob, Hector, $Scott, and Howard...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: What's going on?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: We just found out that someone handed `all` of the Centerscore playbooks over to Wilson High.
nodes.text_bbcode: We just found out that someone handed [color=#e23b3b][i]all[/i][/color] of the Centerscore playbooks over to Wilson High.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The Theater Club script, the strategy for the academic decathlon, all of the soccer plays... Wilson High knows `everything` about us!
nodes.text_bbcode: The Theater Club script, the strategy for the academic decathlon, all of the soccer plays... Wilson High knows [color=#e23b3b][i]everything[/i][/color] about us!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And even worse, it must have been someone from Centerscore High.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: But...

options.label: Who could've gotten to the playbooks?

nodes.text: You're in the hallway, when Jacob runs up to you...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Hey! $Michael! I need your help, man.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: What's up?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I've got the perfect plan for revenge against Wilson High.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: You know that car Alexei's always driving around in? He loves that thing. I'm going to get it and paint it a nice, bright Centerscore green.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: And how are you going to get the car?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Alexei's got this little sister. She's a freshman this year at Wilson. I'm going to start dating her, get her to trust me, then ask her to borrow the keys!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: It's perfect! Not only will dating Alexei's sister really mess with his head, but I'll also get to prank his car.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: That sounds...
You're walking around after school the next day when you see Amanda in an empty classroom, holding a big poster.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Hey, Amanda, what are you working on?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: The Spirit Club poster for the Robot Deathmatch! Look!
She holds it up. It's covered with glittery drawings of horses, puppies, kittens, and a rainbow.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Wow... Not one mention of Centerscore High or Lizards...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Um... That's really...
A little while later, you're practicing with the track team after school when you see your cousin $Kelly walking by.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Hey, $Michael!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Oh, hey, $Kelly! How's Centerscore High treating you?

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Oh, you know, ups and downs... It definitely hasn't been dull!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Yeah, tell me about it...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Hey, $Michael! Come on! Team laps time!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Well, see you later, cousin!
You run back to your team...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: It's nice to see that $Kelly's doing so well!
Later that day, you're walking across school when Mona runs up to you!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: You! You're $Michael, right?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Um, yeah... Who are you?

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: I'm Mona, darling, the crown jewel of the Centerscore Theater department! I heard you've been helping some students out!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Uh... Well... I guess...

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Well... We need help!
You're walking to lunch the next day, when you hear some loud noises coming from the Auto Shop.
The rebels are crowded under the hood of a beautiful muscle car... Sparks shoot out every few seconds!
Off to the side, Kenji holds Megan back...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: What's going on, guys?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: They're hurting her! My '68 Anaconda! It's perfect already!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Are you guys preparing for some kind of Battle of the Schools... Drag race or something?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Battle of the Schools?! Who do you think we are... Jocks?!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Every year, there's a big race between us and Wilson over at the Skyway racetrack, but it has nothing to do with the Battle of the Schools.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Yeah, man, it's just a competition between the two schools that `happens` to take place on the same day `as` the Battle of the Schools.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, man, it's just a competition between the two schools that [color=#e23b3b][i]happens[/i][/color] to take place on the same day [color=#e23b3b][i]as[/i][/color] the Battle of the Schools.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: We started ours first!
Sparks shoot from Megan's car. She struggles to get past Kenji!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Let me go, cousin!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Megan, you agreed to this yesterday!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Yeah, but that doesn't mean I have to `like` it!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, but that doesn't mean I have to [color=#3b78e2][i]like[/i][/color] it!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Can I help out at all?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Yeah, actually. We've been taking turns keeping Megan from strangling whoever touches her car.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: It's my turn to work on the engine... Think you can hold her back?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: If you touch me, freshman, I will erase you from existence.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Um... sure. This will be... Fun.

nodes.prompt: Maybe you should have some lizards on the poster?

nodes.text: On Tuesday, you meet up with Keith...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Nice to see you're so dedicated, $Michael.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I thought we could work on some strength exercises for javelin, since that's the event you'll be trying out for in practice this week.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Cool!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Dex's approach to javelin is mostly cerebral, but like all sports, technique will only get you partway.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Hopefully, you've been working out. Otherwise, you might not be able to do some of these exercises...
That Thursday, you're studying in the library when Keith walks up to you...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Psst... Hey, $Michael, if you want, I have time to show you some techniques for the relay tomorrow...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: But it looks like you're studying pretty hard, so, it's up to you...
At lunch the next day, Kimi waves you over to where she, Sam, and a few other girls are talking.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Hey, $Michael! Have you met Sam's cousin, $ZOE? They're on the cheerleading squad together.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hello.
You're walking through school when you overhear a group of girls talking...
It's the night of the dance!
You're getting ready, when you see the stuffed badger from your boardwalk date.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I could bring it with me, but I'll end up looking pretty silly holding a badger in front of the whole school...
As the team separates, Keith pulls you aside for a moment...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I'm sorry you didn't get to practice your lift... But I had a really good time tonight.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Thanks for inviting me over.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Thanks for helping me out! It was really nice of you. And... I'm really glad you came. You're the best.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: See you at school, okay?
You call up Sierra...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Hey, Sierra! You doing anything tonight?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Hey! The cheerleaders are all going to the beach for a big bonfire tonight to celebrate the new squad.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: It's only supposed to be for cheerleaders and football players... But I bet I can totally sneak you in! As long as you're not worried about getting caught...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I'm not scared. Should I meet you at your house?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Oh, no, no. I'll meet you there. My dad has to... Run an errand... So he's dropping me off. See you soon!
You meet Sierra at the parking lot of the beach at sunset. Down by the shore, a small crowd of cheerleaders and football players are gathered around a bonfire.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Thanks for coming.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Sure, no problem. Uh, were you just waiting in the parking lot?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Um, heh, yeah.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: To tell you the truth, I'm a little nervous. All these popular kids... It's a little intimidating.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: I'm really glad you're here with me.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Aw, don't worry. It'll be fun.
You take Sierra's hand and lead her down to the beach...

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Wow, look how huge that fire is!
One of the cheerleaders spots Sierra and walks over...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hey, Sierra! I'm `so` glad you made the squad! Hey, $Michael. Thanks for all your help on the poster! I didn't know you were on the football team!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, Sierra! I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] glad you made the squad! Hey, $Michael. Thanks for all your help on the poster! I didn't know you were on the football team!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Um, he's not exactly on the team. Is it okay that I brought him?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Uh oh... Taylor's pretty strict about who comes to these things...
Glancing down the beach, you see Taylor yelling at someone...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa! What are `you` doing here?
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa, whoa, whoa! What are [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] doing here?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This party is for football players and cheerleaders only!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Don't worry. I can blend in.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Really? Let's see... Can you pass for a football player? Hmmmm... Oh, I know! What's a field goal worth?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I had a really good time tonight, Sierra.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Thanks for helping me out! It was really nice of you. And... I'm really glad you came. You're the best.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: See you at school, okay?

nodes.text: See you around, Sierra.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Bye!
Zach turns and heads back to the football players.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Sure.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Heh. Sierra is `really` cute... I wonder if she's holding out for a guy like Zach or if...

nodes.text: Well! Thanks for coming with me. This has been a really fun night.

nodes.text: Hey, Sierra? What are you up to tonight?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Hey, $Michael! Some of the cheerleaders are going to the pool hall tonight, and I promised I'd go.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Oh. Sounds like you're busy...

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Hey, wait! Want to come with me?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Sure! I'll meet you there.
You head down to Bill Yard's Pool Hall, where you see Sierra standing with Jessica, the other cheerleaders, and a few football players.

nodes.text: Hey, $Michael! Over here! Jessica and Zach just challenged us to a game!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: That's right! Sierra thinks she's got a chance against us.
Zach playfully nudges Sierra.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Hee hee! We'll see about that. Here, $Michael, take this pool cue. I'm sure we'll make a great team!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Heh. Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Hey, Sierra, first shot's yours. Want me to show you how to hold the pool cue?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: I think I get how it works...
Sierra eyes the cue ball and breaks, sending it crashing into the other balls! Two solid-colored balls go into the pockets.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Whoa! The girl can shoot.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: My dad's been teaching me.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Not bad, not bad at all.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Now, let's see what you've got, new guy.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: You've played pool before, right? We've got the solid-colored balls, and they've got the striped ones.

nodes.text: Just try to hit the cue ball and sink any of the solids.

nodes.text: Yeah, I've played...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: It's just been a while...

nodes.text: Oh, but wait...
Zach points down at the pom-poms Amanda gave you.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: When the football came at you, I think you dropped your... Uh... Pom-poms.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Oh, right, I'm... Uh... On the cheerleading squad.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Heh. All right, tough guy.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Sorry I got in the way of the show.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Hey, it's great knowing you're always going to be there to protect me... Even from pretend bandits!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: So is there anything else you like to do here?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: There's just one last place I like to visit... The Surly Saloon.

Thank you for purchasing Battle of the Schools! First, a brief note.
We wrote Battle of the Schools a long time ago. Not long after writing it, we decided to take SHS in a new direction.
As time passed, Battle of the Schools became less current with the world of SHS.
Couples had broken up, new characters had arrived, and old characters had graduated.
It existed in a weird bubble in the past, like a super fun SHS time capsule.
We've released it now because `one` we spent so much time on it, `two` you deserve a farewell gift, and `three` it's REALLY fun!
Just keep in mind that it's a strange SHS universe...
And please forgive us if things don't work perfectly... We had to dig this up and patch it together on short notice!
Anyway, those are our excuses. Let's get to the fun stuff! Enjoy `BATTLE OF THE SCHOOLS!`
